name: Erica Smith
subject: This is a tough challenge
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY Erica Smith for US Senate 2022
body:
[1]Erica Smith

Yesterday, my team announced our goal of raising $35,000 online before our
very first end-of-month deadline of 2022 in just four days.

I wanted to personally reach out and explain why this goal is so critical
to the success of our campaign. [ https://act.ericaforus.com/go/37170?refcode=em20220127-822&amp%3Bamounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1001&akid=822%2E3698%2EBIA0lg ]If you’re ready to give to our
campaign, please click here to make your first donation of this year.

Running under ultra-partisan, racially gerrymandered district lines — and
winning — is a tough challenge.

Our once-safe, blue seat in North Carolina’s 2nd District is now one of
the few swing districts in the entire country. We need the resources
*right now* to build a campaign big enough to win and protect our
razor-thin Democratic majority in the U.S. House.

Investing in grassroots organizing, digital ads, texting, campaign
literature, and hosting campaign events takes a lot of money — and because
we don’t take a dime from corporate PACs, we’re relying 100% on our
supporters pitching in what they can to fund our campaign.

And the truth is, there’s *a lot* at stake in this election. Congress is
filling up with far-right extremists just like our Republican opponent
Sandy Smith. She is fully backed by Madison Cawthorn, one of the most
dangerous Trump loyalists in the House. And during the January 6th
insurrection, she was at the Capitol, proudly supporting the violence and
participating in the intimidation.

It’s absolutely critical that we defeat Sandy Smith and protect our
Democratic district from Republican scheming.

If we can hit our first end-of-month goal of the Election Year, our
campaign will have the essential resources we need to connect with voters
— but if we miss it, we’ll have to scale back on our plans, which would

# Bill McSwain: I am the best candidate to beat Josh Shapiro
**West Chester, Pa.** **\-- **Bill McSwain, Republican candidate for Governor of Pennsylvania, today participated in the third GOP Gubernatorial Debate at the Blair County Convention Center in Altoona.

Throughout the course of the debate, McSwain shared his plans for restoring PA's economy, promoting public safety and security, and why he is the best candidate to beat Josh Shapiro.

In his opening remarks, McSwain asserted that his background as a native Pennsylvanian, U.S. Marine, prosecutor, and U.S. Attorney makes him uniquely qualified to do whatever it takes to bring prosperity to Pennsylvania:

---
|
> _**"As a native Pennsylvanian, Marine veteran, a federal prosecutor, and a U.S. Attorney appointed by President Trump, public service is in my blood. As Governor, I'll restore freedom and law and order. I'll ensure that every child receives a quality education. I'll revive our economy and restore election integrity to our state and get big government out of the way so our state can thrive." **_
---
| When asked what sets him apart from other candidates, McSwain emphasized that his professional background, significant campaign funding, and status as a conservative outsider make him the only candidate who can beat Josh Shapiro:
---
|
> _**"I can beat Josh Shapiro, and I'm the only one who can. ****I am a true conservative. He’s a liberal. I am a political outsider. He’s a career politician. I believe in freedom. He believes in government control and in mandates. He is a follower. I am a leader. And I am not afraid to stand up for conservative values. I am not afraid to stand up for all of you. And that’s how we’re going to defeat Josh Shapiro and take Pennsylvania back." **_
---
| McSwain also discussed the issues he believes are most important to Pennsylvanians, and promised to fight any and all attempts by progressive leaders to infringe upon personal liberties:
---
| _**"It's time for a Governor with a spine. Someone who is fully committed to protecting your freedoms, upholding law and order, and restoring accountability and security to our elections. I am the only candidate with law enforcement experience and the only one who has prosecuted voter fraud. And I**_** _ will never stop working to protect your liberties. A McSwain administration will mean free enterprise, limited government, lower taxes, hard work, personal responsibility, law and order, educational opportunity, and secure elections - for everyone.”_**

---
|
---
| **BACKGROUND: **
Appointed by President Trump, McSwain's record as US Attorney demonstrates his fierce defense of constitutional rights, dedication to upholding law and order, and history of putting criminals and corrupt politicians in jail. Prior to becoming an attorney, Bill served as a scout/sniper platoon commander in the U.S. Marine Corps. He was born in Philadelphia and raised in Chester County, where he lives today with his wife, Stephanie, and their four children. More information on McSwain's background and platform is available [here.](https://freedompapac.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b9af0aef3fa3167622552aedb&id=a2fef2a21c&e=b1ec95759b)

body:
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us.
[View this message in your browser](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zrjg1acejjfu5puscf3668sl05j3a17neosnqkj8_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgebjqf99jkgqracjkmoq37d1m65qbfctjmkrncst66uqrf91ieoob9crl6uie5sj2usrm5cr4suoj6d5m6ti62p9gc5i6epjhc5hj2p9n6urj1c73mmo7codkelge7dpnq9o74p1m62p6csjk65r61o5kckoe1d9hcjj6cphlcapmcdtietj32c5jcjjr1db5e8gq48bi4bh28or1cpj66pr3c9ie49fg)
This sponsored message from American Action News is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z8e60pdjc6psmuumert69ko2r8su1od0namf7ea8_rp22sh2s8i66ob6cphmeor2cjh2bs) Dear Fellow American, Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This fact means that we’re losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important. To this end, Hillsdale College has produced an online course entitled “The Second World Wars.” Taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson, this course explores how the conflict’s diverse theaters, belligerents, and ways of fighting came eventually to define a single war. And it examines the key investments, strategies, and leaders that led the Allied powers to victory over the Axis. subject: Restoring hope in our country
body:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/vWS3jFiHqN

Our "Introduction to Western Philosophy" course is now available
on DVD. And you can reserve your copy today. Aristotle wrote:
"All men by nature desire to know." The pursuit of knowledge
about the most important things has been the central activity of
Hillsdale College for over 175 years.
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/oWS3jFiHqN

Please see a special message from our
sponsor:

Dear Fellow American,

Our "Introduction to Western Philosophy"
course is now available on DVD. And you can reserve your copy
today.

Aristotle wrote: "All men by nature desire to
know."

The pursuit of knowledge about the most
important things has been the central activity of Hillsdale
College for over 175 years.

In contrast, most American colleges and
universities have embraced the "postmodern" idea that knowledge,
like truth, is relative-that there are no real answers to
questions like "What is the best kind of life?" and "What is the
right way to act?"

In 1931, Winston Churchill wrote an essay
where he imagined a future where mankind had secured a life of
great pleasure, wealth, and convenience. But, Churchill wondered,
would that be sufficient for happiness?

What did they know more than we know about
the answers to the simple questions which man has asked since the
earliest dawn of reason-'Why are we here? What is the purpose of
life? Whither are we going?'

No material progress, even though it takes
shapes we cannot now conceive, or however it may expand the
faculties of man, can bring comfort to his soul.

Hillsdale's free online course, "Introduction
to Western Philosophy," examines just such questions as Churchill
poses.

This course pursues answers to these
questions by studying the arguments of great Western philosophers
such as Plato, Aristotle, Thomas Aquinas, Immanuel Kant, and C.S.
Lewis.

And this 14-lecture course is now available
in a special DVD box set perfect for viewing in your home or a
small group. You might also find it useful for a homeschool
curriculum or personal study.

The "Introduction to Western Philosophy" DVD
box-set can be yours with a tax-deductible gift of $100 or more
to Hillsdale College. Reserve your copy today using this secure
link:

https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/support-introduction-to-western-philosophy-dvd

Hillsdale produces and promotes free online
courses, as we do all of our work while refusing to accept
government funding-not even indirectly in the form of federal or
state student grants or loans.

With your tax-deductible gift today, we can
enroll thousands of Americans in "Introduction to Western
Philosophy" and other online courses on topics such as the
Constitution and American history.

Please help promote Hillsdale's free online
courses such as "Introduction to Western Philosophy" and other
educational outreach efforts in this critical time for America
with a tax-deductible gift.

And remember, when you give a gift of $100 or
more today, we'll send you a special DVD box set of "Introduction
to Western Philosophy" as our thank-you. Quantities are limited,
though, and you won't find this DVD anywhere else but from
Hillsdale.

You can make your tax-deductible gift in
support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts and receive
your DVD box set using this secure link:

https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/support-introduction-to-western-philosophy-dvd

Thank you for partnering with Hillsdale in
its educational mission on behalf of liberty.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since
1844

Hey, friends. One year ago last week, Joe Biden was sworn in as President.
Since then, despite what the GOP wants you to believe, Democrats _have_ actually managed to deliver for Americans on several really important issues. We’ll get to those in just a second, [but first, can you make a donation of any amount to help us flip FL-15 and prevent Kevin McCarthy from ever becoming House Speaker?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/41144611/327545670/-1761186797?refcode=fl_email_fr_20220128oneyear_EG_op_SLB_l2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjIyMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkZGZmOGI5Ni00MjgwLWVjMTEtOTRmNi1jODk2NjUwZDQ0NDIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=A3pgasXZqE2nojfoR_b86aeXD7z4nLCsYjPcxUDP2hY=)

---
Let’s take a look at the two big ones:
* **The American Rescue Plan:** This transformative, direly needed, bipartisan legislation got vaccine shots into people’s arms, delivered cash assistance into Americans’ pockets, invested in small businesses, and helped both schools and businesses re-open safely.

* **The Infrastructure Investment and Jobs Act:** The first (and long overdue) major investment in climate resilience and clean energy, expansion of broadband internet to communities who lack it, improvements to transit and water infrastructure, to name just a few of the benefits. And, it’ll create 2+ million jobs annually for the next 10 years!

In this political climate, with the slimmest of majorities, successfully passing two huge bills that deliver help to Americans who need it is...actually not bad at all!

**$5,800.** That’s the maximum amount that a person can give to a candidate running for Senate. **$23.56.** That’s OUR average contribution this month. And that’s what sets the people-powered campaign we’re building apart from Chuck Grassley’s. Grassley has a $3.7 million campaign war chest thanks to special interests. But I’m not taking money from corporate PACs. **My campaign is funded entirely by people like you, from across the country, giving what they can, when they can.**

What About Our Own?
| | | | |

| [](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001tDI-kNY05AXTtyK_F65ShtFrQt1bQLsxzTNedbixqHECA47U7PTYaft5Rs_OIMZMrajaLiZqm0LV-X4uP5edNYulhQ7UIgOE4datRt3_e4fgks1f7VNP1qsCsgvS32KqwogtPPP2lqVBqhBrvKa0BolJ4tBNw-r8PZdquXYjbuY=&c=GMS_JnK7u3COGxzTRXhOVOgG3c6gPq_ySoEUWs50NYL2Lm444av9XQ==&ch=YGCwhSQe4i2v0_INiFdsGUvzR48NjFSGxOjQBLp3hr2tDY8RvK14oQ==)

| Dear Neighbor,
This week, in an effort to bolster support for military intervention in Ukraine, Biden's Deputy National Security Adviser said Americans should care about Ukraine because "borders should be inviolate....sovereignty should be respected."
Is this a joke? Ukraine's borders and sovereignty? What about our own?
Under the Biden Administration we have experienced:

* The federal government covertly [transporting illegal immigrants](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001tDI-kNY05AXTtyK_F65ShtFrQt1bQLsxzTNedbixqHECA47U7PTYaZ4W3Mxt7VBrZcdJglEh6AQ2y5bUZlUhtkxPI0BQznfY_Fvwk7hp4zyzRRTwh4QUxc9-zMapePIE7i55-8gkZ42rtRlh4Lk2dOt1XHXEC6IIfkeHUmoCyFeUUAfHed95ZkKkIQmIT5mDukDsYpC-7XIoCbBNQcv6RBDAOBbYQFtjJG9j-dWzaOA=&c=GMS_JnK7u3COGxzTRXhOVOgG3c6gPq_ySoEUWs50NYL2Lm444av9XQ==&ch=YGCwhSQe4i2v0_INiFdsGUvzR48NjFSGxOjQBLp3hr2tDY8RvK14oQ==) from southern border states to cities across the country
* A 1,000% surge (in some border sectors) in the the number of migrants infected with COVID-19
* Almost 2 million illegal border crossings at the US-Mexico border in the first seven months of 2021
* Twelve Texas counties declaring emergencies (May 2021) due to the border crisis and the increase in illegal crossings and human trafficking
* An ongoing decrease in the support and provisioning of our border and ICE agents.

Living in Texas, we know first-hand the importance of having a secure border. We know that a country without borders isn't a country. It is vulnerable and weak, rather than secure and strong. We must secure our border, stopping the flow of illegal immigration, crime, and human trafficking that is pouring across it. This isn't uncaring or inhumane. It's common sense.
I am for finishing the wall, provisioning our border and ICE agents with the tools to do their jobs, implementing harsher punishments on human traffickers, and deporting all violent criminals.
We are a sovereign nation. We must act like one. We must secure and protect our border.
---
Fellow Texans, the fight for our country is now, and this 2022 election is our opportunity to elect true, conservative, and common sense candidates who will provide solutions to our crisis at the border.
Send me to Washington. I will fight for America and her sovereignty.
---

Dear Peter,

We're now just months away from the primary election, and our campaign is best positioned to build the diverse coalitions necessary to win and deliver for Wisconsin once in office. We're traveling across the state and intentionally calling for the support of Democrats, Republicans and Independents. We want to raise up the voices of people who have been left out of politics so that we can act on the priorities of Wisconsin’s working families. Not only does this give us a better chance to win, it’s the most effective way to do the work of a U.S. Senator.

Effective representatives build diverse coalitions to pass legislation that positively impacts the lives of everyday people, such as offering skills training for workers, providing clean and affordable energy, and countering gun violence. I spent the last ten years doing this work with the Millennial Action Project, a national nonprofit organization I founded. I have the most federal legislative experience of any candidate in this race and I'm ready for the job on Day 1.

If every Wisconsinite has the opportunity to hear our message, we will win this election. By investing in this campaign, you solidify our position as a top-tier candidacy and build on the momentum we’ve been generating by giving us the means to share our message with more people throughout Wisconsin. Please contribute to our campaign today to help us reach more voters and pave our pathway to victory in this year’s election. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/steven_olikara_for_us_senate?refcode=0128email]

Yours,
Steven

For too long, powerful forces have divided us against each other and left our most vulnerable communities behind. Help us build a new, inclusive and compassionate path forward for Wisconsin, one that champions dignity and opportunity for all. We can meet this moment and change how we do politics.

Friend, We're racing towards the Republican primary in May, and we're grateful for your strong support! Over the last week, we've laid out a bold plan to secure the border, continued meeting voters across Georgia, and answered the tough questions.
---
---
# **_Bold Plan To Secure The Border_**
---
|
---
[](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/0e82897e342bb71a041ad8cde91a9694/37793/a9b2a17cb8bd89e5/b78134f16c20ce9cc3d6b838967d376c/37793)
---
|
---
I wrote an op-ed in Townhall that lays out why securing the border is my top priority, and why it must be the top priority of the U.S. Senate. No piece of legislation deserves a "yes" vote before we vote "yes" on securing the border, and that includes building the wall. [**Read the full column here, and help us share it far and wide.**](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/0e82897e342bb71a041ad8cde91a9694/37793/a9b2a17cb8bd89e5/8ef371fdc5b04741c3d6b838967d376c/37793)

# **_Augusta Exchange Club_**
---
[](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/0e82897e342bb71a041ad8cde91a9694/37793/a9b2a17cb8bd89e5/fd82290b27357a0ec3d6b838967d376c/37793)
---
Enjoyed being in Augusta last week and sharing our message at the Augusta Exchange Club! Grateful to everyone who joined us. Georgians know this election is about the security of our nation — and they know I have the trusted experience to deliver results. [**Read some coverage here.**](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/0e82897e342bb71a041ad8cde91a9694/37793/a9b2a17cb8bd89e5/1f53c2b34f593541c3d6b838967d376c/37793)
---
---
# **_The John Fredericks Show_**
---
[](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/0e82897e342bb71a041ad8cde91a9694/37793/a9b2a17cb8bd89e5/a8a7dfff1d44bc3fc3d6b838967d376c/37793)
---
Had a great and wide-ranging conversation on The John Fredericks Show earlier this week! We talked about what it's going to take to win in November, what Georgians are looking for in a U.S. Senator, and what we must do in order to clean up the Swamp. [**You can listen to the full conversation here.**](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/0e82897e342bb71a041ad8cde91a9694/37793/a9b2a17cb8bd89e5/b7e2feb212a34d36c3d6b838967d376c/37793)
---
---
# **_"Totally Unfair"_**
---
[| | |
---|---|---](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/0e82897e342bb71a041ad8cde91a9694/37793/a9b2a17cb8bd89e5/94933b127260ae79c3d6b838967d376c/37793)
In a recent interview, Herschel Walker had no answer for how he would've voted on the $1.2 trillion infrastructure bill that had very little at all to do with infrastructure. **Instead, he said it was "totally unfair" to ask how he'd vote on legislation. ** I would've voted "NO" on that infrastructure bill, and I made my position clear months ago. Furthermore, **answering questions about legislation is exactly what a candidate for U.S. Senate should do.** Hiding might be what's best for Herschel's campaign, but Georgians deserve better. [**I hope you'll watch this important exchange here and ask yourself who's most qualified to serve in the U.S. Senate.**](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/0e82897e342bb71a041ad8cde91a9694/37793/a9b2a17cb8bd89e5/6ff48e6f74d144bbc3d6b838967d376c/37793)
---
---
# **_One More Thing_**
---
Please follow our campaign's [**Facebook**](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/0e82897e342bb71a041ad8cde91a9694/37793/a9b2a17cb8bd89e5/cbc4f07e8729f20bc3d6b838967d376c/37793), **[Twitter](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/0e82897e342bb71a041ad8cde91a9694/37793/a9b2a17cb8bd89e5/7d09d0889c0f0f42c3d6b838967d376c/37793)** , and [**Instagram**](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/0e82897e342bb71a041ad8cde91a9694/37793/a9b2a17cb8bd89e5/7795612984ff9ecbc3d6b838967d376c/37793) pages if you aren't already, and make sure 10 of your friends are too! This campaign is heating up, and this week we learned that Raphael Warnock has $23 MILLION on hand to keep this seat, and with it the Senate, in Democrat hands. [**I hope you'll help ensure we have the resources to compete by donating whatever you can here and now.**](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/0e82897e342bb71a041ad8cde91a9694/37793/a9b2a17cb8bd89e5/8686c62457a3a902c3d6b838967d376c/37793) Thank you again for your friendship, prayers, and support!
---
[](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/0e82897e342bb71a041ad8cde91a9694/37793/a9b2a17cb8bd89e5/a41044a82fb54644c3d6b838967d376c/37793)
---
Gary Black
---
[**DONATE NOW »**](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/0e82897e342bb71a041ad8cde91a9694/37793/a9b2a17cb8bd89e5/16dff5428c361052c3d6b838967d376c/37793)

I couldn’t be prouder to have you on our team, and your support is absolutely crucial to our efforts. Here’s why.
Raphael Warnock has already stockpiled $23 million to keep this seat, and with it the U.S. Senate, in Democrat hands. Democrats know, as we know, that this seat will decide who controls the majority, and I’m the only Republican who can win. But in order to do so, we have to start now. And these emails are a vital part of our efforts.
With one conservative vote, we can restore Republican leadership to the U.S. Senate and help take America back. I’m ready — and if you are too, I hope you’ll donate here or below.

1 in 4 veterans have been diagnosed with behavioral health challenges like PTSD, and veterans make up 1 in 12 homeless individuals in America. Caregivers often go without compensation, survivor benefits are weak, and the VA isn’t reaching its potential.
My plan aims to address all of these issues, and more. The American Heroes Plan would provide tax incentives to businesses hiring veterans, expand access to caregiver programs and survivor benefits, and invest in housing and health care access for our veterans.
**To my fellow veterans: When you were called to serve, you stood up. It’s time America did the same for you and your families.**
Sincerely,
Dr. Kermit

clean_body: | = Friend, I served two tours in Iraq as a Navy doctor, deployed with the famous Purple Foxes — the brave Marines who evacuate our service members from active battle fields. I understand many of the issues facing our veterans, because I’ve lived them. Today I’m releasing The American Heroes Plan – the actions I will take when elected to Congress to ensure that our government is serving those who served us. | = = 1 in 4 veterans have been diagnosed with behavioral health challenges like PTSD, and veterans make up 1 in 12 homeless individuals in America. Caregivers often go without compensation, survivor benefits are weak, and the VA isn’t reaching its potential. My plan aims to address all of these issues, and more. The American Heroes Plan would provide tax incentives to businesses hiring veterans, expand access to caregiver programs and survivor benefits, and invest in housing and health care access for our veterans. To my fellow veterans: When you were called to serve, you stood up. It’s time America did the same for you and your families. Peter,

Republicans of the Tennessee State Legislature are back at it, putting forward bills that will stifle progress and privatize every aspect of our lives.

Here’s some of the nonsense from Tennessee Republicans:

- “A Masterclass in Gerrymandering”: Tennessee Republicans have rigged the game for themselves, ripping apart our communities and ensuring they maintain unchecked power for at least another decade. They’ve robbed people of a voice and are trying to eradicate democracy — which is why we are preparing a lawsuit against them as we write this.
- “Sodom and Gomorrah”: State Representative (and insurrectionist) Terri Lynn Weaver (R-Lancaster) compared Broadway in downtown Nashville to “Sodom and Gomorrah.” Listen, Broadway might not be for everyone but let’s not moralize and hint at wanting to control people’s behavior. As much as it might pain some Republicans, this isn’t a theocracy.
- Letting Teens Purchase Firearms: A bill proposed by Rep Chris Todd (R-Jackson) would lower the legal age to carry a concealed handgun from 21 to 18. We raised the smoking age and the drinking age to 21 to protect our kids, but, according to Republicans, it’s ok for teens to own firearms? It doesn’t make sense.

Luckily, we have some amazing Democratic Senators and Representatives fighting tooth and nail against every bad bill Republicans put forward, but we need more of them. Republicans control both chambers with a supermajority — that has to change.

Can you chip in now so we can organize to elect more Democrats to break apart the Republican supermajority? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tndemocraticparty]

body:
Here's a list of steps you need to take to become a delegate.
| | | |
---

Calling all Geoff Diehl supporters!
We need you to help Geoff by signing up to be a delegate at the Massachusetts Republican State Convention on May 21.
It's easy to become a delegate, but you must follow a specific series of steps. Here's what you need to do:

* Delegates are elected from each community by Republican Town and Ward Committees. If you're not already in contact with your local ward or town committee, please check [this list](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001RII_WgMkNiJNQgEBw1x_MWw0x6D9tz5BS1ua4UsubgANgcZcWI0a4oRRvetIoehmM0a0h9o7UCm8VNz7CmLK2ScjAzzgPqDajhI_UBwDphYGCx8fKE__jgzmsl48Q9jDsvV5DYddTIsya7eLwtdRDD4LNvGPnnuX-NUix8NyKGw=&c=juGKI8RT4Qn-pUxvlgiZuzzIO-Q1jXFMDwxD10JWIPVUw9U4dtDfiw==&ch=1l_dqe_UEBI67YJoJafIJj3qLiva5gyX9POxVZV72R0eSPvs0tSlXg==) for information.

* Town and Ward Committees will hold a caucus sometime before the end of February to elect delegates. Be sure to find out when your local caucus is scheduled and attend the meeting.

* Once you're elected to be a delegate, you'll receive further instructions from the MassGOP.

* To attend the Convention, you must register as a delegate and pay a delegate fee. If the fee is paid before March 15th, it will be $125 per person. After March 15th, it will be $150 per person.

* The MassGOP will publish a list of hotels with reduced rates in the event that you wish to arrive in Springfield on the night before the Convention.

* The Convention will take place on Saturday, May 21, 2022. Make sure you attend the Convention and vote for:

---
---
---
City, Town, and Ward Committee Chairs, please take note of the following rules for the holding of caucuses and registration of delegates from your community:

* Each Republican Town/Ward Committee in Massachusetts MUST hold its caucus before the last day of February, 2022.

* The Republican Town/Ward Committee MUST post mail a letter to each of its members, informing him/her when and where the caucus will be held. This letter must be postmarked 7-10 days prior to the date of the caucus. (Failure to mail this letter to each member of the committee may result in the delegates from your town being disqualified from attending the convention). The same notice must be sent to the MassGOP at 400 West Cummings Park, Suite 5650, Woburn, MA, 01801, and to the Committee's elected State Committee representatives.

* The Republican Town/City Committee may publicize the caucus to all registered Republicans in the town/city, via the newspaper, social media, email, or other means.

* Check with the MassGOP as to how many delegates your town is allotted for the convention.

* Many Republican elected officials in your town may serve as "ex officio" delegates. You can obtain a list of these elected officials from your town clerk (selectman, school committee, city councilor, state representative, state senator, etc.) These individuals do not take spot of a delegate because they are already an elected official.

* The meeting must be only a caucus and no other items of discussion may be on the agenda.

* At the conclusion of the caucus, fill in the Elected Delegate Report provided to you by the MassGOP, and return it to the MassGOP:

Attn: Report of Convention Delegates 400 West Cummings Park, Suite 5650 Woburn, MA 01801
---
---
We'll see you in Springfield!

The fate of the House is going to come down to our race in Wisconsin. And this race is going to be close.

Right now, it's a toss up whether we win this race and give President Biden a Democratic majority he can work with -- or kiss our chances of making progress goodbye.

body:
Clay is a lot of things: a father, an activist, a singer, and a good neighbor. But none of those reasons are why we at Equality PAC chose to endorse Clay Aiken for North Carolina’s 6th Congressional District.
We chose Clay because of his compassion and commitment to service. Can you rush $5 to Clay’s campaign today? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ca_eom?refcode=01282022_EOMFR_1&amount=5]
contribute [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ca_eom?refcode=01282022_EOMFR_1&amount=5]
Clay and I both started off as teachers before moving into politics. Having spent more than twenty years in the classroom and as a member of the teachers' union, I know that educators bring a needed perspective and experience to Congress.
It is a perspective driven by a passion for improving the lives and opportunities of all, not by special interests. Clay’s background in special education and disability advocacy makes him uniquely qualified to fight for American families in Congress.
Clay’s historic campaign tells kids across North Carolina that they are welcome and safe, and shows the LGBTQ community in every corner of our country that loud, hateful rhetoric isn’t who we are as Americans.
Clay’s first end-of-month fundraising deadline is on Monday at midnight. I’m personally asking you to support and donate to Clay’s campaign right now. Can I count on you? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ca_eom?refcode=01282022_EOMFR_1&amount=5] [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ca_eom?refcode=01282022_EOMFR_1&amount=5]
give now [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ca_eom?refcode=01282022_EOMFR_1&amount=5]
In 2012 I made history by becoming the first openly gay person of color elected to the United States Congress. It’s time to make history again by electing Clay as the first openly gay congressmember from the South.
Thank you,
Mark Takano, co-chair of Equality PAC
Clay is running for Congress in the North Carolina 6th. He was born, raised, and is currently raising his son in the Triangle. He's running to use his voice to speak up and stop the loudest voices on the far ends of the political spectrum from sucking up all the oxygen in our political discourse.

name: Tobias Read
subject: We don’t get do-overs in education
body:
It seems more and more often these days that Oregon makes the news for all of the wrong reasons.
---
| | Dear Peter, It seems more and more often these days that Oregon makes the news for all of the wrong reasons. **[This time we’re leading the nation in falling high school graduation rates due to the pandemic and our response to it.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/41165940/327621011/1325806321?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83NzI2MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxOGZlYjZhZC02NzgwLWVjMTEtOTRmNi1jODk2NjUwZDQ0NDIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=h3kmSXzfgK33Zr6u0rBhnExcuXMmPWhr0-fWtsqdhws=&emci=eec66e52-6180-ec11-94f6-c896650d4442&emdi=18feb6ad-6780-ec11-94f6-c896650d4442&ceid=30662126)** As a result, graduation rates in Oregon slipped by 2%, **one of the largest drops in the country.** [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/41165942/327621013/1325806321?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83NzI2MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxOGZlYjZhZC02NzgwLWVjMTEtOTRmNi1jODk2NjUwZDQ0NDIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=h3kmSXzfgK33Zr6u0rBhnExcuXMmPWhr0-fWtsqdhws=&emci=eec66e52-6180-ec11-94f6-c896650d4442&emdi=18feb6ad-6780-ec11-94f6-c896650d4442&ceid=30662126) It gets worse. Last school year, the number of students who finished the year on track to graduate on time dropped 10%, and attendance has declined dramatically. **This is a crisis that threatens the future of our kids and our state. ** That’s why we have to do better. We can’t afford to leave kids hungry or without access to high speed internet. We can’t move them in and out of the classroom multiple times per year. We have to tackle the staffing crisis, and provide more support to educators and families so students can catch up and keep learning. **Our teachers and administrators have done amazing work.** Teachers have been asked to take on responsibilities that go far beyond educating our kids. They pour their souls, energy and frequently their own money into helping kids learn and survive. And they are doing this all in the midst of a pandemic. **This is a failure of leadership and vision.** Oregon can no longer tolerate that 1 in 5 kids fail to graduate on time. Or that only half of all third graders in Oregon can read at grade level. Or that almost 20 percent of kids are chronically absent. Our kids deserve better. I’ve said since the beginning of this campaign: **I’m running for Governor to bolster our schools and get our kids on track to a better future.** But I need your help to do it. **[Please, will you consider a contribution to my campaign today so we can do what needs to be done for our students?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/41165944/327621015/990444423?refcode=em012822-1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83NzI2MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxOGZlYjZhZC02NzgwLWVjMTEtOTRmNi1jODk2NjUwZDQ0NDIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=h3kmSXzfgK33Zr6u0rBhnExcuXMmPWhr0-fWtsqdhws=)** Stay safe,

# Hello!
Here's your weekly roundup of important stories you may have missed both locally and nationally!
---
|
---
|
## [**Supreme Court Justice Stephen Breyer Announces Retirement**](https://jessicaforwis.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c27543103b71c2381252057eb&id=200c78b222&e=42a933bda9)
---
| [ ](https://jessicaforwis.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c27543103b71c2381252057eb&id=2127e259fb&e=42a933bda9)
---
| Liberal Supreme Court Justice Stephen Breyer formally announced his retirement yesterday. He has served for more than two decades on the United States’ highest court. This gives President Biden a very important opportunity to fill this vacancy with another liberal justice. Biden has vowed to nominate a black female to the bench. This comes at a crucial time while Democrats still hold a 50-50 split in the Senate, which would require Vice President Kamala Harris’ vote in case of a tie when the Senate would be to confirm Biden’s nomination. Justice Breyer is to step down at the end of the current term, and Biden is expected to act quickly on this opportunity to allow Breyer’s successor to serve when the next term starts on October 3rd of this year.

[Read Justice Breyer's remarks on retiring and his hope in the American 'experiment'](https://jessicaforwis.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c27543103b71c2381252057eb&id=a3592834b1&e=42a933bda9)
---
|
---
|
## [**Update on Republicans' Fraudulent Electors**](https://jessicaforwis.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c27543103b71c2381252057eb&id=952729f639&e=42a933bda9)
---
| [ ](https://jessicaforwis.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c27543103b71c2381252057eb&id=afde955c6f&e=42a933bda9)
---
| The US Department of Justice (DOJ) has launched an investigation into the attempt by Republicans in Wisconsin and other battleground states to change election results to falsify electoral votes for Former President Donald Trump. A year ago, Milwaukee County District Attorney John Chisholm was asked to launch an investigation into this, and his office more recently asked Attorney General Josh Kaul to look into it as well. Kaul felt that the U.S. DOJ was the “most appropriate place to handle the complainant” being that other states also had similar documents of falsifying election results. As reported earlier this week, Scott Fitzgerald, had a role in this as well and also needed to be investigated. Deputy Attorney General Lisa Monaco advised Wednesday that the Justice Department had started investigating “fraudulent elector certifications”. Congressman Mark Pocan compares the false documents to the attempted insurrection on January 6th as they were both attempts to overthrow the election results. The other states in which investigations are to be occurring are Arizona, Georgia, Michigan, New Mexico, Nevada and Pennsylvania.
---
|
---
|
## [**US Ambassadors to be Evacuated from Ukraine**](https://jessicaforwis.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c27543103b71c2381252057eb&id=899ee556d2&e=42a933bda9)
---
| [ ](https://jessicaforwis.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c27543103b71c2381252057eb&id=06f65e55f3&e=42a933bda9)
---
| It was announced Sunday evening that the State Department will begin evacuating families and nonessential staff from the US Embassy in Kyiv due to Russian military threat.. White House Press Secretary Jen Psaki noted in a briefing that the US does not intend to carry out Afghanistan-like military evacuation and Americans should leave Ukraine now. The UK’s Foreign Office also announced that they too will withdraw embassy staff from Kyiv as well. In the travel advisory from the State department, it was said that US citizens should depart using commercial or other private transportation, and that security conditions in Crimea and Ukraine are unpredictable and can deteriorate with little notice in these Russian controlled regions. Officials would not offer estimates of how many Americans are still in Ukraine and how family members will be evacuated due to a lack of data. However they did note that the US government will not be in a position to evacuate these Americans due to the military action that could be launched by Russia at any time.

name: Peter Franchot
subject: Rebuilding trust in state government
body:
[https://nvlupin.blob.core.windows.net/images/van/NGP/NGP10/1/81826/images/FAWlogo_Blue%404x.png]Dear Peter,
In challenging times like these, Marylanders look to the government for help. Last year, I am proud to say that the Maryland Comptroller’s Office rose to the challenge by disbursing hundreds of millions of dollars in COVID financial assistance to our citizens in record time. Here’s a quick breakdown of my record on delivering COVID relief:
[https://nvlupin.blob.core.windows.net/images/van/NGP/NGP10/1/81826/images/covidrecord_1200x1200.png]Unfortunately, unacceptable delays caused by other state agencies meant that for many Marylanders, this aid simply didn’t come fast enough. The Maryland Department of Labor completely dropped the ball on keeping up with unemployment claims as citizens lost their jobs, and the Maryland Department of Education experienced significant delays in processing federal grant money for child care providers.
For many months, I’ve taken state agencies to task for their sluggish rollout of federal pandemic aid to our families and businesses most in need. When the government can’t even get the basics right, it’s no wonder that the public loses faith in the government’s ability to execute bigger ideas and bolder action.
Failures like these have lowered public trust in the competence of state government. That’s why if I’m blessed to be your next Governor, I’ll make sure government once again delivers results for our working families. You deserve responsive, respectful, and results-oriented service – and under my leadership, that’s exactly what I will deliver.
Click here to learn more about my plan to rebuild trust in the competence of state government. [https://www.franchot.com/rebuildtrustinstategov]
Thank you,
[https://nvlupin.blob.core.windows.net/images/van/NGP/NGP10/1/81826/images/Franchot%20Signature.png]

subject: my recovery
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Mark Kelly for Senate
body:
There are days where the wind is at your back and you feel as if nothing can possibly get in your way.
#

Friends —
In my recovery, I learned that healing takes grit.
There are days where the wind is at your back and you feel as if nothing can possibly get in your way.
Then there are the days with setbacks and challenges that make you question whether your goals are possible and you have to find the strength to carry on the fight.
Sometimes you find that strength in yourself. Sometimes others provide it for you.
I feel the same way about Mark’s campaign for Senate — if we are going to re-elect Mark and continue healing this country, we need grit. The stakes are just too high. It can come from within or from outside. And sometimes it comes from both places.
So yes, Mark may face millions of dollars in attack ads.
And yes, Donald Trump may tell his supporters that ”taking America back” begins with beating Mark.
But what matters most is how we respond.
Mark is strong, but he cannot do this alone. He needs your strength and support as well if he’s going to win.
[**Can I count on you to make a contribution — $3 or whatever you can afford — to Mark’s re-election campaign before his first fundraising deadline comes to an end? clean_body: There are days where the wind is at your back and you feel as if nothing can possibly get in your way. Friends — In my recovery, I learned that healing takes grit. There are days where the wind is at your back and you feel as if nothing can possibly get in your way. Then there are the days with setbacks and challenges that make you question whether your goals are possible and you have to find the strength to carry on the fight. Sometimes you find that strength in yourself. Sometimes others provide it for you. I feel the same way about Mark’s campaign for Senate — if we are going to re-elect Mark and continue healing this country, we need grit. The stakes are just too high. It can come from within or from outside. And sometimes it comes from both places. So yes, Mark may face millions of dollars in attack ads. And yes, Donald Trump may tell his supporters that ”taking America back” begins with beating Mark. But what matters most is how we respond. Mark is strong, but he cannot do this alone. He needs your strength and support as well if he’s going to win. | Peter,
Serving my community on the frontlines as a law enforcement officer for 33 years, I've seen firsthand what's needed to keep neighborhoods here in Nevada safe.
And that's something that Steve Sisolak is simply failing to provide.
He's sided more with criminals than law-abiding Americans - so when I saw the opportunity to stop that threat to public safety by running for Governor myself, I took it.
You should never have to worry about your street, community, or city becoming more dangerous as a result of poor leadership from Carson City.
Help Me Keep Our State Safe: https://secure.winred.com/lombardo-for-governor/before-the-weekend
But even though I'm a political outsider, I quickly realized that making this campaign successful was going to require the support of folks like you.
When you contribute even just a few dollars, we're able to make sure that our critical operations on the ground have the proper resources they need for victory, as we get closer and closer to November.
It makes sense that the people I ultimately will serve are the ones who drive this campaign - so before the weekend, I was hoping you could help keep up the support since we're still a bit short on our January goals.
Will you help get our campaign for safety and prosperity on track for a victory by keeping up this grassroots support?
Give Us A Boost Before the Weekend: https://secure.winred.com/lombardo-for-governor/before-the-weekend
Thank you,
-Sheriff Joe Lombardo

Hi friends, When I first met Doug Gansler, some 40 years ago, he was the same person he is today: energetic, committed and purposeful. Both of us have sprouted some gray hairs in the years since -- in my case, more than some. **But when I hear Doug campaigning for governor, I hear the same passion he has displayed throughout his career.** He truly cares about the underdog. He truly cares about making government work for everyone. He truly cares about people who have not enjoyed the privileges that he has enjoyed. His focus on state government is an especially sweet spot for me. I have long thought that Annapolis -- and not Washington -- is the place to make real, lasting progress for Maryland and Marylanders. Doug sincerely shares that view.

That's the quality that we need in our next governor -- not the habit of go-along-get-along, but real leadership. Looking around our country, it’s clear that people are suffering.

The gap between the rich and the poor in this country is widening, and people at the bottom are being left to fend for themselves. Children are going hungry, and people are being forced to choose between life-saving medications or their rent. This isn’t how it should be.

This is a time when the government should help. People shouldn’t have to choose between these basic needs.

But even with my own party in charge, we aren’t doing enough. I knew I couldn’t sit back and watch this happen.

As an experienced reformer, I’m running for Congress to give power back to everyday people and take on the status quo that has shut them out for far too long.

I am fighting to reform our justice system, end the death penalty once and for all, make housing more affordable, and protect our environment. We will never be able to make life better for the people of the Black, Brown, and poor communities until we are able to fix these systemic issues.

But Peter, first I need your help. Our end-of-month fundraising deadline is a few days away, and I need your help to hit our goal. Hitting this goal is critical to the success of my campaign.

name: Great America Update
subject: Survey on an urgent matter
body:
A movement is growing, led by progressives—but supported by many well-meaning Americans—to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. [](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/BC.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c612934%7c6771%7c6%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c1&wdmdk=maHUWzjH3nv2Tv7HYNcotQ&sysid=1)
This sponsored message from Great America Update is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c69747%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=yUF7l7asUTv8vwPSnlg5cQ&sysid=1) Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation’s future. A movement is growing, led by progressives--but supported by many well-meaning Americans--to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That’s why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue--views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c69748%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=P9AA4QRgk2rikxdzkVKd3A&sysid=1)** For most of our nation’s history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government. **But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.** This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America’s schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics--too many Americans simply don’t understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states. These efforts, which aim to counter the Left’s domination over most of our schools, include:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as “Constitution 101” and “The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;”
* **Reaching** over 5.6 million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale’s free digest of liberty;
* **Promoting** constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;
* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America’s founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America, as well as to members of our armed forces; and
* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education through Hillsdale’s Barney Charter School Initiative, which launches and provides guidance to classical K-12 charter schools nationwide.

Your answers to the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty--including the importance of the Electoral College. **And this is especially important in this critical time for America’s future.** So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our **National Survey on Presidential Selection** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. **You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:** **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c69748%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=P9AA4QRgk2rikxdzkVKd3A&sysid=1)** And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift. Since 1844, Hillsdale has been “pursuing truth and defending liberty.” Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts, while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work. Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention--and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844
---

Your answers to the National Survey on Presidential Selection will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty--including the importance of the Electoral College. And this is especially important in this critical time for America’s future. So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our National Survey on Presidential Selection and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below: And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift. Since 1844, Hillsdale has been “pursuing truth and defending liberty.” Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts, while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work. Please represent your state and take the National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention--and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. | **_On Justice Breyer's Retirement_**
---
| On Wednesday, news broke that Associate Justice Stephen Breyer would be retiring from the Supreme Court at the conclusion of the current term, which ends in late June. Democrats have been pressuring him to retire since last July in an attempt to give Joe Biden a _much-needed_ first year "win." Justice Breyer resisted such pressure and was heavily criticized by Democrats. Now there are reports that he was "blindsided" and "stunned" by the leak of his retirement.

Unfortunately, in yielding to the progressive wing of his party, Joe Biden will likely nominate a candidate much more liberal than Justice Breyer. As Sen. Mike Braun noted in his [statement](https://indgop.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=89fb3de929a99eecb88e6fb27&id=7ae83ec9ec&e=1acd9bb3d6), Joe Biden's coddling of the far left throughout his presidency leads one to believe such. Instead, Joe Biden should put forward a dedicated constitutionalist who respects the rule of law and our nation's system of checks and balances.

Sen. Todd Young has [called for](https://indgop.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=89fb3de929a99eecb88e6fb27&id=c90ff69364&e=1acd9bb3d6) a "thorough but fair vetting" of the potential nominee, which he correctly notes President Trump’s Supreme Court nominees never received. Let's not forget: Democrats tried to smear Neil Gorsuch as a [sexist](https://indgop.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=89fb3de929a99eecb88e6fb27&id=f4f20780b5&e=1acd9bb3d6), accused Brett Kavanaugh of [perjury](https://indgop.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=89fb3de929a99eecb88e6fb27&id=5fb5eacdf1&e=1acd9bb3d6), and called into [question](https://indgop.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=89fb3de929a99eecb88e6fb27&id=11876a73fa&e=1acd9bb3d6) Amy Coney Barrett's Catholic faith.

Of course, this wasn't all too surprising. After all, it was Joe Biden who turned the confirmation process into a "[blood sport driven by character assassination](https://indgop.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=89fb3de929a99eecb88e6fb27&id=b4f9da7791&e=1acd9bb3d6)" back in 1987.

Enjoy this week's newsletter and share it with a friend.

Best,

Chairman Kyle Hupfer

| **_Camp Atterbury & A Rails-to-Trails Honor_**
---
|
---
---
| _(Left) Gov. Holcomb speaks with members of the National Guard. (Right) Gov. Holcomb speaks on the artwork created by the refugees and Hoosier artist Tiffany Black._
---
| On Monday, **Gov. Holcomb** was joined by Aaron Batt, federal coordinator of Operation Allies Welcome, to announce the upcoming end of the joint mission at Camp Atterbury that helped settle 7,201 vetted Afghan refugees into a new life in America. Camp Atterbury first began accepting refugees on Sept. 1, 2021, and provided them with lessons on life in the U.S. and worked to prepare them with job training and life skills for what lies ahead, including English classes. Hoosiers came together and donated 2.6 million items to assist the refugees with their first Hoosier winter; about 700 of the refugees will call Indiana home. "I think about this journey, that these 7,200 that found their way to Indiana, this journey away from oppression and a war-torn country to this place of peace and promise," reflected **Gov. Holcomb**. "These were giant steps in lives."
---
|
---
|
---
| On Tuesday, Rails-to-Trails Conservancy named **Gov. Holcomb** as the next Doppelt Family Rail-Trail Champion for his leadership in accelerating trail development across the state. Among his accomplishments is the _Next Level Trails_ program, an innovative state funding program that RTC says could provide a model for other states looking to accelerate trail development nationwide. **Gov. Holcomb** is the 40th honoree and the first acting governor to be recognized as a Rail-Trail Champion. You can learn more about the recognition [here](https://indgop.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=89fb3de929a99eecb88e6fb27&id=a4e911f431&e=1acd9bb3d6).

| _(Top) Sen. Todd Young, joined by Rep. Greg Pence and Indy Right to Life President Marc Tuttle, speaks during the March for Life rally. (Bottom Left): Secretary of State Holli Sullivan applauds Sen. Todd Young's speech. (Bottom Right): Hundreds of Hoosiers march down W Market Street in Indianapolis._
---
| On Monday, days after the 49th anniversary of the Roe v. Wade decision, Sen. Todd Young, Rep. Greg Pence, and Indiana Secretary of State Holli Sullivan joined hundreds of Hoosiers at the fifth annual "March for Life" rally held outside of the statehouse.

In his remarks during the rally Sen. Young stated, "I believe this will be the last anniversary in which Roe v. Wade is the settled law of the land and this is where the real work starts."

# De Gregorio Announces Expansive Support from Bergen District Chairs
---
| **FAIR LAWN –** Today, Nick De Gregorio, a Marine Veteran and Republican Candidate for Congress in New Jersey’s Fifth Congressional District, proudly announced the overwhelming support of current Bergen County District Chairs, along with the backing of a former Chairman of District 38, which is currently vacant. "Nick is the next generation of leadership our country so sorely needs \- plain and simple. Defeating Josh Gottheimer, whose vote is one of the only things Joe Biden and Nancy Pelosi can count on these days, is no small task. Only Nick has both the discipline and strength to lead us through one of the most competitive races in the country and to a new Congress that will keep Biden's disastrous agenda in check."

**Joseph Crifasi**
Legislative District 36 and Carlstadt Municipal Chair

**Angela Hendricks**
Legislative District 37 and Acting Hackensack Municipal Chair

**Thomas J. Fellig **
Glen Rock Municipal Chair,
Former Chair of Legislative District 38 (Vacant)

**Steven Hopper**
Legislative District 39 and Park Ridge Municipal Chair De Gregorio had previously announced that his campaign would report $403,000 raised on its year-end report for 2021 with $360,000 cash on hand. He has also announced the support of District 39 Assemblyman Robert Auth (R, Old Tappan) and Assemblywoman DeAnne DeFuccio (R, Upper Saddle River), along with an impressive showing from CD5 municipal chairs.

clean_body: Rep. Davis is using his Congressional Funds to help him win | | | Team, Some of our staff got a small booklet in the mail this week, the Danny K Davis Year End Report. The thing is, most of us haven’t heard from Rep. Davis in years. Suddenly he’s decided it’s important that we know what he is up to. If you got it too, you may have noticed something else in the fine print on the back: Paid for by official funds authorized by the House of Representatives. That’s right, members of the House of Representatives are allowed to use money from their official budget to send mail in an election year. Money that should be spent on our community through constituent services or on work raising awareness of the challenges our community faces every day. If you’ve been reading the emails you already know where Kina stands–she believes our elected Representatives should be out pounding the pavement for their constituents all day, every day. Kina knows being in Congress is about giving our community a seat at that table. It's about ending the painful cycle of leaving the Westside and Southside of Chicago behind, year after year. With Kina in Congress, we won’t have to wait for a mailer once every few years to know how she is fighting for us. We’ll see it every day. Thank you, Team Kina | To give by check: Kina Collins for Congress 901 Lake Street, Unit 4093 Oak Park, IL 60301

We can’t afford to fall behind and lose our momentum, so I’m asking this team to step up and help defend and expand our Senate majority.
#
Peter,
The outcome of the 2022 election is going to determine so much about our country’s future. From protecting reproductive rights to addressing the child care crisis to building back fairer and stronger from this pandemic, there is so much at stake – and we can’t waste a single moment.
Every day in the other Washington, it’s becoming clearer and clearer that Mitch McConnell’s GOP and the special interests that are supporting Republican candidates around the country are looking to rip back control of the Senate and dismantle all of the progress we’ve made.
**[We have our first big deadline of the year coming up on Monday. We can’t afford to fall behind and lose our momentum, so I’m asking this team to step up and help defend and expand our Senate majority. Will you rush in $5 or whatever you can spare before midnight to ensure we meet our $20,000 end-of-month goal to keep the Senate blue?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/41173505/327649344/-623632754?refcode=pm_em_220128_1&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=18326&firstname=Peter&lastname=&addr1=&city=Cresco&state=PA&phone=&employer=&occupation=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDM4NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwZjc1MzdmMy03YzgwLWVjMTEtOTRmNi1jODk2NjUwZDQ0NDIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Qh3xVSnEiAlmog7Wam9cSrQEjITEeuPJdDw2suc2pF4=)**

There is no way around it. What we saw unfold last week in Laredo makes one thing clear: South Texans deserve far better than what Henry Cuellar is giving. Last Wednesday, the FBI raided Henry Cuellar’s home and campaign office. They even seized his property as evidence, in part of a court-ordered investigation by the federal agency that handles corruption and bribery cases. To this day, Cuellar refuses to be transparent with his constituents on why he is involved. We deserve a transparent Congressperson who is focused on serving the District, not someone who makes us question what their true intentions are. With less than five weeks until the TX-28 Democratic primary, we must do all we can to send Jessica Cisneros, a true progressive champion, to Congress. But we know the fight to defeat Henry Cuellar won’t be easy. Despite the FBI probe, he’s determined to get re-elected. # Bill McSwain Applauds Commonwealth Court Ruling that Act 77 is Unconstitutional

**West Chester, Pa.** **\-- **Bill McSwain, Republican candidate for Governor, had this to say in response to the Friday morning [Commonwealth Court ruling](https://freedompapac.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b9af0aef3fa3167622552aedb&id=6b2af5bcc9&e=b1ec95759b) that Act 77 is unconstitutional:
---
|
> _**"Act 77 has wreaked havoc across our state and robbed voters of confidence in their elections. Any politician who supported this unconstitutional bill on either side of the aisle is unqualified to be Governor.
>
> As U.S. Attorney and as a candidate for Governor, I have consistently called Act 77 unconstitutional, and applaud the Commonwealth Court for recognizing it as such. As Governor, I will return Pennsylvania to the system of in-person voting that has served us well since our Commonwealth's constitution was written. Further, I will implement commonsense reforms, including universal voter ID, the banning of private funding of our election system, and the elimination of ballot harvesting. Finally, I will appoint a Secretary of the Commonwealth to oversee our elections who will carry out my vision of election security, accountability, and transparency." **_
---
|
---
| Read McSwain's op-ed on his plans for election security and integrity reforms [here](https://freedompapac.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b9af0aef3fa3167622552aedb&id=7b5cde6728&e=b1ec95759b).
---
|
---
| **BACKGROUND: **
Appointed by President Trump, McSwain's record as US Attorney demonstrates his fierce defense of constitutional rights, dedication to upholding law and order, and history of putting criminals and corrupt politicians in jail. Prior to becoming an attorney, Bill served as a scout/sniper platoon commander in the U.S. Marine Corps. He was born in Philadelphia and raised in Chester County, where he lives today with his wife, Stephanie, and their four children. More information on McSwain's background and platform is available [here.](https://freedompapac.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b9af0aef3fa3167622552aedb&id=4ffbd380d7&e=b1ec95759b)

| | **\- INDems to Launch “The Jobs Tour”, Statewide Effort Touting How Democrats Created Indiana Bright Economic Future -** This coming Monday in Merrillville, U.S. Congressman Frank J. Mrvan and the Indiana Democratic Party will launch the “The Jobs Tour”, a statewide effort to share how Hoosier Democrats - not Republicans - are responsible for the bright economic future for families and communities across the state. Thanks to the [American Rescue Plan](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/41175923/327659255/2075701864?FFF.01.28.22=FFF.01.28.22&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82NzYzNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzYTk1MGNhMy04NTgwLWVjMTEtOTRmNi1jODk2NjUwZDQ0NDIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogIkRQV0lMTElTNjdAR01BSUwuQ09NIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=_ZdtOC0VwJRwXAkvdPwyN8rUtqBpd0Gfm9Qq5vDNsZQ=&emci=7c5834f6-7680-ec11-94f6-c896650d4442&emdi=3a950ca3-8580-ec11-94f6-c896650d4442&ceid=4925535) and [The Jobs Act](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/41175925/327659257/2091091387?FFF.01.28.22=FFF.01.28.22&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82NzYzNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzYTk1MGNhMy04NTgwLWVjMTEtOTRmNi1jODk2NjUwZDQ0NDIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogIkRQV0lMTElTNjdAR01BSUwuQ09NIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=_ZdtOC0VwJRwXAkvdPwyN8rUtqBpd0Gfm9Qq5vDNsZQ=&emci=7c5834f6-7680-ec11-94f6-c896650d4442&emdi=3a950ca3-8580-ec11-94f6-c896650d4442&ceid=4925535), Democrats like U.S. Congressmen André Carson and Frank Mrvan secured total funding for the state’s READI program, more than $900 million of state construction projects, and transformational investments that will expand broadband internet access, revitalize water systems, fix community infrastructure needs, and repair crumbling roads and bridges across Indiana. **Democrats created this bright economic future for Hoosier families, and “The Jobs Tour” will celebrate how these kitchen table issues were made possible when it mattered most.** About 15 additional stops will follow Monday’s launch and stops will be held in every Congressional district of the state. Further, the tour continues the Indiana Democratic Party’s commitment to meet voters and families where they are. Additional details of stops are forthcoming, but by the end of the 2022 election cycle, Indiana Democrats will have held campaign events in every one of the state’s 92 counties. Every community and county matters, and Democrats are ready to share how they delivered and stood by Hoosier families - regardless of region or political opportunity.
**\- State Rep. Michelle Davis Admits Trans Athletes Do Not Have Advantage in Sports During Hearing For Her Own Bill, House Bill 1041 - ** This week, Democrats criticized State Representative Michelle Davis and the Indiana Republican Party for acknowledging the sham behind her own legislation, House Bill 1041. During a committee hearing, Representative Davis admitted [there were no current state cases](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/41175927/327659259/323189783?FFF.01.28.22=FFF.01.28.22&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82NzYzNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzYTk1MGNhMy04NTgwLWVjMTEtOTRmNi1jODk2NjUwZDQ0NDIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogIkRQV0lMTElTNjdAR01BSUwuQ09NIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=_ZdtOC0VwJRwXAkvdPwyN8rUtqBpd0Gfm9Qq5vDNsZQ=&emci=7c5834f6-7680-ec11-94f6-c896650d4442&emdi=3a950ca3-8580-ec11-94f6-c896650d4442&ceid=4925535) where transgender athletes had an unfair competitive advantage to their cisgender peers. But in the most telling moment, the Indiana GOP allowed a national hate group - Alliance Defending Freedom (ADF) - to publicly announce its support of HB 1041. | MONTGOMERY, TEXAS - Representative Majorie Taylor Greene (GA- 14), Madison Cawthorn (NC-11), Troy Nehls (TX-22), and Lance Gooden (TX-05) join Senator Ted Cruz and the House Freedom Fund in endorsing Christian Collins in his race for Texas' eighth congressional district.
Christian Collins is a sixth-generation Texan, the son of missionaries, and the founder of the Texas Youth Summit. Early last year, incumbent Kevin Brady (TX-08) announced his retirement from Congress, setting off a scramble amongst Republicans in the eighth congressional district. Collins is a front runner and remains the most conservative candidate in the crowded field.
"Christian is a fierce conservative and strong fighter for President Trump's America First agenda," said Representative Gooden. "He'll be a great addition to our Texas Republican delegation."
First elected in 2018, Congressman Lance Gooden represents Texas' 5th District in the U.S. House of Representatives. The 5th District stretches from Dallas County to Cherokee, Henderson, Kaufman, Anderson, Van Zandt, and Wood Counties. Gooden was adopted at birth and understands, more than most, the importance of the sanctity of life. He has also been an unwavering supporter of President Trump and holds one of the highest Liberty Scores.
"Christian is an embodiment of the next generation of Conservative leaders," said Representative Marjorie Taylor Greene. "He has proven himself to be a fearless freedom fighter who will put America first. I have no doubt that he will stand up to the Washington swamp and be the voice for his constituents and the American people."
Marjorie Taylor Greene is one of the most conservative members of congress. Time and time again, Greene has stood up for the rights of the unborn, a secure southern border, and President Trump's America first policies. As a former small business owner and entrepreneur, Greene understands the struggle of everyday Americans and will never stop fighting for them.
"Christian Collins is an American patriot who won't back down to the RINOs and sellout in Congress," said Representative Cawthorn. "He is the true America First candidate running in Texas' 8th district. I'm proud to join my great friends Representative Gooden and Senator Cruz in endorsing him."
Madison Cawthorn is an 8th generation resident of North Carolina's 11th Congressional district. With the incredible support of his family, friends, and thousands of patriots from across Western North Carolina and the country, Madison Cawthorn achieved the unthinkable on November 3, 2020. As the youngest Congressman in modern history, Madison Cawthorn set out to prove his critics wrong and his supporters right, and he did just that!

Friend: This is a longer and especially important email about why I'm running for Senate. It's important for me to share my story with you and why this campaign means so much to me. I hope you'll give it a read.
I was raised in Jacksonville, Florida – and I've got to say, when you grow up in the South poor, Black and female, you've _got_ to have faith. It's something I learned from my parents. Mom was a maid, Dad was a janitor, and my goodness they worked _hard._ And although we didn't have a lot of money – although life was tough sometimes – we had each other. We had love. We had _faith. _I've carried that spirit with me my entire career.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/41176286/327660923/-892300846?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk2252-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84Mzc4NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyNmRkMmU1Ni04NjgwLWVjMTEtOTRmNi1jODk2NjUwZDQ0NDIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=CiL5QfQX76icfcI2MDWb3yZChOO-2kcGEB90wleJNoI=)
That faith that things can get better, that we can do some good in the world, inspired me to get into public service. In fact, my mom used to say to me, "Never grow tired of doing good, Val – _never_ tire." And so for me, growing tired was never an option. It's what pushed me to become the first in my family to graduate college. It's also what pushed me to serve 27 years in the Orlando Police Department, where eventually I became the first woman to lead the department. And it pushed me to run for Congress and represent my community.
**[I will never tire of the opportunities to do good or the challenges to tackle before me, and I'm asking you to do the same. Pitch in a contribution of $5 or more now to help me defeat Marco Rubio, win in Florida and defend our Senate majority.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/41176287/327660924/-892300846?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk2252-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84Mzc4NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyNmRkMmU1Ni04NjgwLWVjMTEtOTRmNi1jODk2NjUwZDQ0NDIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=CiL5QfQX76icfcI2MDWb3yZChOO-2kcGEB90wleJNoI=)**
_Never tire._ These are the words that resonate in my mind each and every day that I serve the people of Florida's 10th District in Congress. They've stuck with me as I've fought to put an end to gun violence, especially as the horror of that violence struck our district at Pulse Nightclub in Orlando. We mourned, deeply. But we resolved to fight for change, to never tire – and I won't stop until long-overdue action on gun violence is finally realized.
_Never tire,_ I said to myself as I took on a habitual offender who occupied the most powerful office in the world: President Donald Trump. Unlike some in Washington, I _never tire_ of standing up for what I believe is right, and I carried that with me as I fought to impeach him, because no one is above the law.
This is my story, friend: Only in America can a little Black girl, the daughter of a maid and a janitor growing up in the South in the '60s, have a story so filled with opportunities like these. Now, I'm ready to meet a new moment, to do more good for Floridians.** ****I am ready to be the next U.S. senator for Florida – and together, with you never tiring alongside me, I know we can win.**
[**So I need your support, friend. This campaign is a battle of many things, and an unfortunate reality among them is** _resources._**The Republican Party is already proving they will spend whatever it takes to protect Marco Rubio, so if you're with me, if you want to elect Florida's first Black senator and defend our majority in the Senate, please donate $5 or whatever you can right now.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/41176288/327660925/-892300846?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk2252-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84Mzc4NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyNmRkMmU1Ni04NjgwLWVjMTEtOTRmNi1jODk2NjUwZDQ0NDIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=CiL5QfQX76icfcI2MDWb3yZChOO-2kcGEB90wleJNoI=)
Thank you for being in this with me. _Never tire._

Val Demings
| | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/41176289/327660926/1804727444?refcode=jtk2252-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84Mzc4NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyNmRkMmU1Ni04NjgwLWVjMTEtOTRmNi1jODk2NjUwZDQ0NDIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=CiL5QfQX76icfcI2MDWb3yZChOO-2kcGEB90wleJNoI=) **Val Demings here:** I can’t thank you enough for fighting alongside me to flip Florida blue. Florida will determine whether Democrats keep our Senate majority – that’s why Republicans are pouring millions of dollars into this race to crush our movement _and_ keep Florida red _permanently_. Our grassroots campaign is off to a great start, but in a race as close as this one, I need your help to surge ahead and defend the Senate. **Paxton's Patriots Daily Update January 28, 2022**

Peter,

The secret to winning in Georgia – especially – in GA-14 is to reach every voter, not just the ones we know will agree with us. Every person in GA-14 is someone who has issues and challenges that we can fix together, regardless of party. **We need to go**** _everywhere_****and talk to**** _everyone_****.**

When Team Holly went on our first tour of the district we learned a lot. Including that 12,000 likely dems are unregistered in GA-14. That's why we have the largest voter registration effort that Northwest Georgia has ever seen. But now it’s time to make sure we speak to every single voter – and these efforts cost money and time.
****
[There are 468,681 registered voters in GA-14. We’ve set a goal to raise fifty cents per voter to help us hire organizers, set up events, and door knock. That means we need to raise $60,844.5 to reach every voter in GA-14.

_**Can Holly count on your help to reach every voter?**_

Team Holly is not going to leave our neighbors behind. You cannot expect to win in GA-14 if you disregard our rural counties, which are so vital to the future of this state.

This is why Marge parachuted into our district for an easy win. But not this time.
