name: Team AOC
subject: Alexandria needs your help
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
From day one, we have been defined by people-power. In 2020, we beat millions in corporate and special interest dollars with a movement. And we’re going to do it again. By once again proving that people-power is winning power.
# [](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/143?refcode=em20220128-2754-header&t=1&akid=2754%2E2526796%2E7fEASk)
We’re exactly **five months out** from Alexandria’s 2022 primary election.
We can’t take anything for granted. Last year Alexandria faced a record 13 opponents during the primary and a $10 million challenge during the general. **And, already, she has three opponents raising thousands against her — including that same challenger from the last general election.**
So we’re going to need your help to build the powerful momentum and organizing program we’ll need to keep Alexandria in Congress fighting for our communities.
**We are still 33% away from the $150,000 fundraising goal we set for January. And it’s incredibly important that we hit every fundraising target from here on out through to the general election.**
[Will you be one of the folks we need to step up and make a contribution — of any amount — today to get us to our $150,000 fundraising goal and ensure we have the resources to win the primary election in five months?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/aoc-email-20220128?refcode=em20220128-2754-P_FND_EOM_GOL&t=2&refcode2=2754_2526796_7fEASk&akid=2754%2E2526796%2E7fEASk)
**[Donate now](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/aoc-email-20220128?refcode=em20220128-2754-P_FND_EOM_GOL&t=21&refcode2=2754_2526796_7fEASk&akid=2754%2E2526796%2E7fEASk)**
**From day one, we have been defined by people-power.** In 2018, we beat a machine with a movement. In 2020, we beat millions in corporate and special interest dollars with that same movement. And we’re going to do it again. How? By once again proving that people-power is winning power.
Across the country, people look towards our campaign as a vanguard of progressive change. Every person who donates to Alexandria’s reelection isn’t just endorsing her — **they’re endorsing our movement and everything we’re fighting for.**
That has an impact. When other members of Congress or politicians see thousands of grassroots activists aligning themselves in support of Medicare for All, a Green New Deal, and a livable minimum wage, it entices them to join our cause.
**But building a movement takes work. And there are already opponents aligning to try and stop our momentum. That’s why we’re asking you to step up today:**
[If you’re able to, please make a contribution today to fund Alexandria’s reelection campaign and keep her in Congress fighting for us all.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/aoc-email-20220128?refcode=em20220128-2754-P_FND_EOM_GOL&t=22&refcode2=2754_2526796_7fEASk&akid=2754%2E2526796%2E7fEASk)
Thank you for everything.
Pa’lante,
Team AOC
**[Donate now](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/aoc-email-20220128?refcode=em20220128-2754-P_FND_EOM_GOL&t=23&refcode2=2754_2526796_7fEASk&akid=2754%2E2526796%2E7fEASk)**

During World War II, he served in the Army helping to manufacture ammunition and other critical supplies, then went on to own his own business. Even when he was working hard to support our family, he still made time to spend with his kids. I remember being six years old sitting at the kitchen table solving the “problem of the day” with him. Those “problems of the day” were a lesson that you work any problem till you solve it, and I’ve carried that determination with me wherever I’ve gone.** In medical school and then working at Philadelphia teaching hospitals though, I never imagined that determination to solve problems would lead me to running to become the first woman to represent Pennsylvania in the U.S. Senate. body:
Military spending has gotten completely out of control.
#
Peter, one thing Pramila has been working on since coming to Congress is cutting the excessive, bloated military budget.
**Military spending has gotten completely out of control,** and it only benefits weapons manufacturers and defense contractors. Last year, Congress even increased defense spending to an amount more than Donald Trump’s last military budget. That is completely upside down.
Last week, Pramila introduced a resolution in the House to cut military waste, stop selling weapons to international human rights abusers, and focus our foreign policy on diplomacy instead of a constant over-reliance on military force.
[**Peter, can you sign on to Pramila's resolution as a citizen co-sponsor? Together we can cut excessive military spending and focus our international relations on peace and diplomacy instead of war.**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/signup/foreign-policy-resolution-2022/?source=em20220128-991&t=1&akid=991%2E420207%2E7u82E2)
**[Add your name](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/signup/foreign-policy-resolution-2022/?source=em20220128-991&t=2&akid=991%2E420207%2E7u82E2)**
**Our country must redefine and reimagine what it means to be strong.** Being strong is NOT giving more money to a bloated Pentagon budget that is already larger than the following 11 countries’ military budgets combined. That’s why Pramila has championed a 10% cut to military spending and voted NO on last year’s defense budget.
We can strengthen our country by focusing foreign policy on peacebuilding and use a slashed military budget to put money towards guaranteeing health care for all, raising wages, investing in child care and education, fighting for our unions and labor protections, and so much more.
The resolution is wide-ranging, recognizing the global security challenges of a new nuclear arms race and instability from climate disasters. It aims to stem violent conflict spurred by U.S. military intervention and weapons sales to oppressive regimes.
Our fight for peace and transformative change is only as powerful as our grassroots movement. And we need to let Congress know there’s a wave of support behind cutting a bloated Pentagon budget and focusing on international diplomacy. [**Sign on now to be a citizen co-sponsor of Pramila's resolution to change the way we approach foreign policy and end excessive military spending.**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/signup/foreign-policy-resolution-2022/?source=em20220128-991&t=3&akid=991%2E420207%2E7u82E2)
**[Add your name](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/signup/foreign-policy-resolution-2022/?source=em20220128-991&t=4&akid=991%2E420207%2E7u82E2)**
In solidarity,
Team Jayapal

Some billionaires pay NO income taxes, while folks like us can’t use the same work-arounds and loopholes.
**Join Melanie D’Arrigo in demanding an equitable tax system that bridges the massive wealth inequality gap.**
[**Sign and send the petition: Congress must ensure the rich and corporations pay their fair share!**](https://u1584542.ct.sendgrid.net/ss/c/P8Elou2Rvc0qoMPEUZrMXcOpy_XqN4R2ZGjoK-5zZnlYAl02bjDvkWw-bt61mximrPJghK7tbNB2GgOJ5CdiZXDkp3tEEaRxiq5EbsPqzJd8fCe5nnwq9rtaJIzVJo3LFsEKRUyzv3cGu5TGGunu7bqFMyTI4Xu8Cebo9pY1gKdgvGGg_ol2R8ypi53XA3Tuzif19OaKePMoby2r6zD2-VqqXghSI5bGN0GhihN5XqNf5KBL-WHSHWtRG4ImCqcFZQNSCGkbWwS_EKJdQ18YzREXgg2R8xLyDQdZDOe2LRZ7Ptz_hC_fBr6cLJXFakkKAf08VTVIRlsMD5HFArJC8D7JFriG3c4rY3Dz9xbOaTmCWAH83NZw12cprdM7Hl13tr44svX1top_b1_iYd2rr0MXmi2R524jKRWP3NS-Ng7Iu8QTpiNQq8QzEbcH0ThFFgk0P6no3AeWEuoL8W-8M3aDDkqUlIKcKdGjEHA7OHZY6SXfH17d1IkH5Qqlr9eQndwnfrd_2lc-pJU4SMaRkku0E0EZc74XiAXhIBjW9G5cDnSPsOc7nHi6Z89bRq01pg0tmE0UTAAcr1zCrBDp1pD-iIf7FsmQtM4eGtdxelsgAB-XIROym4Er_SvUQGvJ5WQdVP5HJPKTUz9CfP_PSAmjS4z54endSuEycHzD16E/3j3/oZVoozw1RRuvUIgCBeJr_w/h0/1-Ujc_V3cx3MktTVEPAnImtkzNXaH_jCTmva6xSpk3E)
Billionaires have actually increased their total wealth by more than 70% during the pandemic, while working Americans have struggled to pay the rent and put food on the table.

**We need a tax system that addresses deep wealth inequalities and puts us on a path towards economic justice.**

| VA Delegate John McGuire (Navy SEAL - Father - Business Owner)

|
---
| The General Assembly convened on January 12, marking the beginning of the 402nd legislative session of the House of Delegates.
---
| We have much work ahead of us to make Virginia the best place to live work and raise a family. It is honor to be your voice and fight for you in Richmond. We are getting after it!
---
| "Predator Protection Act"
---
|
---
| Success: Our bill with Delegate Scott Wyatt to repeal the Predator Protection Act HB257 with Senate amendments, which allowed the Loudoun County school board to try to cover up sexual battery of a child, just passed the education committee 16-5. Our children are number one and it is unconscionable to think that school administrators should sweep this conduct under the rug, instead of informing parents and law enforcement. This is a bill to fix the egregious Democrat policy, which ended mandatory reporting of sexual batter in schools to police. This bill is on its way to the floor. Five Democrats voted against it.

body:
This says a lot about the current status of the campaign. Take a look if you can today:
#
Hey, Derek — we're almost at our first end-of-month fundraising deadline for 2022.
Remember, the news media (and our GOP opponents) are going to scour these numbers next quarter to gauge our campaign’s momentum.
A lot of donations? _That means John Fetterman has the momentum to win._
Too few donations? _That makes John Fetterman look beatable._
Because this is high stakes stuff, we generally try to make a really big push right before these deadlines.
**Derek, the truth is, we're behind where we need to be for the month. And if we don't see a quick surge of support, we could miss our goal.** We were trying to find out why, and then we logged into ActBlue noticed this... our average donation has gone down since our campaign first began:
[](https://act.johnfetterman.com/go/42106?refcode=ema20220128-4368&t=1&akid=4368%2E434096%2E0DAPiv)
**We started up there in the $31 range. Now we're down to $24.03.**
In a weird way, we're proud of it! Here's why:
A low average donation is the hallmark of a real people-powered campaign. It shows that we’re not funded solely by a bunch of rich elites with deep pockets.
But, on the other hand, it means the money we used to raise from two donations — well, now we need nearly three to raise the same amount!
**We can't afford to miss our goal because of the aforementioned high stakes — reporters, media narratives, yada yada.** So, we're asking everyone who hasn't donated to make their very first contribution to John Fetterman today — that'll help us close the gap.
**[Can you make your first $5 donation right now to help John Fetterman reach our first end-of-month goal of 2022? Every donation helps us show the strength and size of this grassroots campaign to flip PA blue.](https://act.johnfetterman.com/go/42106?refcode=ema20220128-4368&t=2&akid=4368%2E434096%2E0DAPiv)**
**[Contribute $5](https://act.johnfetterman.com/go/42106?refcode=em20220128-4368&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=21&akid=4368%2E434096%2E0DAPiv)**
Look, if you can give ANY amount at all today, that makes you a hero in our books. Seriously, it means a lot to us.
If you can't give today, we understand, and that's OK too.
**At the end of the day, we're proud that we're the only campaign in this race with way more than 375,000+ grassroots contributions.** It says a lot about the kind of inclusive, grassroots movement we’re building. And it means a lot when it comes to flipping a swing state like Pennsylvania.
Thank you for all you do.
— Team Fetterman
P.S. Even if you can't donate $31 or $24 or anywhere near our average donation, any amount you can spare *really* helps. And if you're the kind of person who can afford to do more, that helps a lot too. **[So, please, consider making a donation now before our deadline hits.](https://act.johnfetterman.com/go/42106?refcode=ema20220128-4368&t=22&akid=4368%2E434096%2E0DAPiv)**

**[Donate](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-emails?refcode=em20220128-4368-footer&t=23&refcode2=4368_434096_0DAPiv&akid=4368%2E434096%2E0DAPiv)**
---

Email us: info@johnfetterman.com

I believe we need to address climate change to stop these megafires. Doug LaMalfa believes climate change is a hoax |
# [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/41167007/327625414/390307162?refcode=em-header&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTYyOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3M2Y0ZDgyYS02YzgwLWVjMTEtOTRmNi1jODk2NjUwZDQ0NDIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=vNFJgqSePKGWYtx1CxG9WjZBAH-rqK6EznfqMGh_G9M=)
Friend,

There's a lot going on in the news, but one issue that's never out of mind in the North State is**forestry and fire suppression.**

Our communities have been ravaged by fires over the past three years. In 2018, The Carr Fire burned down 1,600 structures -- including my brother's home. The Camp Fire caused $16.7 billion in damages. Last year saw the largest fire in state history -- The Dixie Fire -- destroy the town of Greenville and cost $630 million to extinguish.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/41167008/327625415/360059203?refcode=em-1.28.22-all-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTYyOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3M2Y0ZDgyYS02YzgwLWVjMTEtOTRmNi1jODk2NjUwZDQ0NDIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=vNFJgqSePKGWYtx1CxG9WjZBAH-rqK6EznfqMGh_G9M=)
_It wasn’t long ago the skies looked like this in the Bay Area. It can happen again if we don’t act._
It's easy to succumb to hopelessness, especially as these fires grow in intensity as a consequence of a changing climate, but it doesn't have to be this way. We don't lack solutions to wildfires -- we lack the political willpower and bipartisan resolve to implement them.

**My opponent Doug LaMalfa sits on the Agriculture Committee’s Subcommittee on Conservation and Forestry, but he hasn't done nearly enough to prevent wildfires in the North State. He excels at photo ops, but doesn’t do the research to hold the Forest Service accountable to do their jobs.**

It's simple: I believe in science. Doug LaMalfa does not.

I believe we need to address climate change to stop these megafires. Doug LaMalfa believes climate change is a hoax. _We can and must do better._

**[If you are ready to be part of the solution, chip in $3 to my grassroots campaign today. Hi Peter, I've just published a new blog post: [This Is Not a Drill](https://kevinkiley.nationbuilder.com/r?u=Bjc8XUdeJ9yV6eR3mI9Z6HRd5urWv8u8i-Pa-jQziooT0rFDhGq_k-ob6vabfBSzL3jNgIYXroyai73wd77oYw&e=eff202566bfe6143aa18c9c627e100fe&utm_source=kevinkiley&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=jan28_final&n=1) On Monday, the Assembly will vote on the Single Payer bill. AB 1400 abolishes private insurance and has the government take over healthcare. It would double state taxes. Apparently, this is not a drill. Democrat leaders are vowing to “make sure members who vote ‘no’ on the legislation will not be endorsed by the California Democratic Party for the upcoming election.” The craziest thing is this might not be the worst bill in the Legislature. That distinction goes to SB 871, which mandates the vaccine for kindergarten and up, or SB 866, which removes parent consent. Even the LA Times opposes this outrageous legislation. It’s no wonder we've reached a dubious milestone in the California Exodus. In a new report, U-Haul reveals it literally ran out of trucks to accommodate people fleeing the state. The meme calling Newsom their "Salesman of the Year" is certainly on target. On a related note, new jobs numbers are in. You’ll never guess which state has the highest unemployment this month. Hint: it’s the same as the last 3 months. The big news out of Congress is that Nancy Pelosi is running for reelection. This raises the stakes in our race, as winning this seat could be the key to ending Pelosi’s Speakership. It’s all the more reason we need Republicans in Congress who will _fight_. [Help me fight for California in Congress](https://kevinkiley.nationbuilder.com/r?u=09K6E4GvoPozZ73mzf50y5etLj1_9wCfyRoQ3wvVmv-GOhHPWzgYbh54Gph7Pyuk3g2mp41Qa8XyLKk0CnWqFcPhfo-70bh2d9FGRmWv-G172QGsW76cwQP_qMTr_tK1&e=eff202566bfe6143aa18c9c627e100fe&utm_source=kevinkiley&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=jan28_final&n=2) [Share this Post on Social Media](https://kevinkiley.nationbuilder.com/r?u=27Ax0UmWOX2J8J_QwK9Z6lpHI-UVcODcFSdMgu5zpAwb20iYun67GxeTqWTI_J73C10NEvlAV68MzxVU5gkOKg&e=eff202566bfe6143aa18c9c627e100fe&utm_source=kevinkiley&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=jan28_final&n=3) Kevin Kiley

| | Fellow Patriot:

Last week, my RINO opponent Steve Womack _lobbied the Biden Regime on behalf of China_ , _begging Beijing Biden to __cut tariffs imposed by President Donald Trump on Chinese-made imports_.

He signed a letter sent to U.S. Trade Representative Katherine Tai urging her to allow hundreds of “Made in China” imports—worth billions of dollars—to avoid American tariffs originally levied by the Trump Administration.

President Trump imposed these Section 301 tariffs after decades of greedy, rootless D.C. insiders selling the American worker down the river to China, during the course of which millions of American jobs were outsourced and offshored to China and the American manufacturing sector wholly eviscerated, resulting in the death of hundreds of communities and fueling the opioid crisis.

**Steve Womack is Walmart’s bag man, and thus China’s bag man****. **

He’s whored himself out for corporate contributions since his first campaign 12 years ago, and the American family has paid the price. Womack’s pockets are lined with tattered American Dreams, his hands red with the blood of Arkansas’s working men.

President Trump’s economic nationalism was a threat to Walmart Womack’s America Last grift, so he’s doing everything he can to go back to the way things were—when America was just a piggy bank for the rest of the world, stripped down and sold for scrap.

__But Arkansans don’t want to go back to the way things were.__

As usual, the solution to Chinese domination is the exact opposite of what Walmart Womack wants to do.

Thank you for your generous support of Tom's campaign! Keep reading for a recap of his time on the campaign trail, an update on upcoming events, and ways to get involved.
#

**Team Tom Weekly Update | Friday, January 28th, 2021**
Peter,
This week, Tom participated in a gubernatorial forum hosted by the Maryland State Education Association. Tom proved to Marylanders why we need him to be the next Governor of our state -- he has the bold, progressive vision necessary to ensure that ALL Marylanders thrive and have access to a quality, equitable education.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/41180096/327676292/1024535149?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTMyNCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlZjkwMGZmNS05NjgwLWVjMTEtOTRmNi1jODk2NjUwZDQ0NDIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=rMEa1kHaK1BWEYpOR_2YAkn2wIzyWvNlbR057soJ0Xg=&emci=6755c7b7-9680-ec11-94f6-c896650d4442&emdi=ef900ff5-9680-ec11-94f6-c896650d4442&ceid=14684837)

Thank you all for your continued support, and we look forward to staying in touch.

Jessica Semachko
Campaign Manager

* * *
**On the Campaign Trail**
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/41180098/327676355/1083112743?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTMyNCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlZjkwMGZmNS05NjgwLWVjMTEtOTRmNi1jODk2NjUwZDQ0NDIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=rMEa1kHaK1BWEYpOR_2YAkn2wIzyWvNlbR057soJ0Xg=&emci=6755c7b7-9680-ec11-94f6-c896650d4442&emdi=ef900ff5-9680-ec11-94f6-c896650d4442&ceid=14684837)
Tom started out his week with the Jerry Samet District 14 Democratic Club where he shared his vision for our great state and listened to what they want to see in their next Governor of Maryland.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/41180099/327676356/1083112743?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTMyNCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlZjkwMGZmNS05NjgwLWVjMTEtOTRmNi1jODk2NjUwZDQ0NDIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=rMEa1kHaK1BWEYpOR_2YAkn2wIzyWvNlbR057soJ0Xg=&emci=6755c7b7-9680-ec11-94f6-c896650d4442&emdi=ef900ff5-9680-ec11-94f6-c896650d4442&ceid=14684837)
When unions thrive, we all thrive. On Monday, Tom joined public employees from AFT-Maryland to thank them for their service to our state, and share his vision for being their partner when elected Governor.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/41180100/327676357/1083112743?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTMyNCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlZjkwMGZmNS05NjgwLWVjMTEtOTRmNi1jODk2NjUwZDQ0NDIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=rMEa1kHaK1BWEYpOR_2YAkn2wIzyWvNlbR057soJ0Xg=&emci=6755c7b7-9680-ec11-94f6-c896650d4442&emdi=ef900ff5-9680-ec11-94f6-c896650d4442&ceid=14684837)

clean_body: Thank you for your generous support of Tom's campaign! Keep reading for a recap of his time on the campaign trail, an update on upcoming events, and ways to get involved. Team Tom Weekly Update | Friday, January 28th, 2021 Peter, This week, Tom participated in a gubernatorial forum hosted by the Maryland State Education Association. Tom proved to Marylanders why we need him to be the next Governor of our state -- he has the bold, progressive vision necessary to ensure that ALL Marylanders thrive and have access to a quality, equitable education. You can watch the forum . Thank you to President Cheryl Bost and MSEA for hosting the forum, and for allowing Tom to share his vision. As our Governor, Tom will ensure that students, educators, and school employees have everything they need to succeed. Thank you all for your continued support, and we look forward to staying in touch. Many thanks, Jessica Semachko Campaign Manager Tom Perez for Maryland On the Campaign Trail Tom started out his week with the Jerry Samet District 14 Democratic Club where he shared his vision for our great state and listened to what they want to see in their next Governor of Maryland. When unions thrive, we all thrive. On Monday, Tom joined public employees from AFT-Maryland to thank them for their service to our state, and share his vision for being their partner when elected Governor. Tom also connected with hundreds of folks from Baltimore County virtually this week at both the Southwest Baltimore County Democratic Club on Tuesday, and the Baltimore County Progressive Democratic Club on Thursday. He was honored to engage in discussion with key serial activists who work hard to ensure all Marylanders have access to opportunity in Baltimore County and across Maryland. On Wednesday, Tom spoke with public school educators from across the state at the Maryland State Education Association’s gubernatorial forum. He shared with Marylanders his visions to fully fund and implement the Blueprint for Maryland’s Future so every student has access to a world-class education and can realize their full potential. In the News "In Maryland, the primaries are more competitive, but the outcome still likely won’t change the fact that Democrats are favored in the fall. Notable Democratic candidates include state Comptroller Peter Franchot, former Democratic National Committee Chair Tom Perez, former Prince George’s County Executive Rushern Baker and nonprofit executive Wes Moore." body:
Hey folks! We’ve been out on the road all week, traveling across rural Wisconsin to talk about Sarah’s new plan for our communities.

From broadband expansion to lowering health care costs to fixing childcare deserts and more, there’s so much ground to cover and it’s a lot of time on the road. But Sarah firmly believes that hearing from people first-hand makes her a better public servant and it’s how we’re going to defeat Ron Johnson in November.

Here’s the challenge we’re facing right now: We’re going to need a lot of resources to keep going, but being on the road so much leaves less time for fundraising. That means we rely on contributions to messages like this one.

Our monthly fundraising deadline is coming up in just a few days, and we’re having a tough time reaching our goal. Ron Johnson doesn’t have to worry about deadlines like this because he’s got a rolodex full of wealthy donors who can write a $2,900 check just like that. Unlike him, we’re counting on grassroots donors to keep us going.

He’s lived there, and worked there, and raised children there, and sent them to the district’s public schools. He knows what this district’s working families need: a fighting chance, and a member of Congress who won’t hesitate to fight for them. He didn’t get into politics because he wanted a fancy title. No — he ran for office because he was on a mission. A mission to raise the standard of living for families. To put power in the hands of the working class. To make it quick and easy to form a union and bargain collectively. To advance human rights around the world. To defend our planet from climate change while delivering a bright new era of good-paying, union jobs in clean energy. He fights from the heart AND he knows how to get results. That’s my favorite type of fighter. **We need his voice in Washington. But he’s going to need our help to get reelected.** [**_If you can, please make a donation to help reelect Andy right now. I’m running for all the kids with big dreams like me.

| | Dr. Yadira Caraveo is a pediatrician, state representative, and daughter of immigrants. She’s running to represent Colorado’s new Congressional district in Congress and to be the first Latina to represent Colorado in Congress. Dr. Caraveo has been endorsed by **314 Action, Elect Democratic Women, and EMILY’s List**. She’s ready to take on tough fights in Congress. I always wanted to be a doctor, Peter.

When I was in med school, there weren’t a lot of other students who looked like me — who spoke Spanish at home, whose parents worked blue-collar jobs, and who had to take out hundreds of thousands of dollars in loans just to be there.

But with the support of my family and my community, I put myself through school and achieved my dream.

I want every single kid across Colorado’s 8th district to be able to achieve their own dream too.

That’s why I’m running for Congress — for all the kids out there with big dreams like me.

Dear Friends,
This evening, Governor Baker delivered his final State of the Commonwealth Address.
Alongside the Governor's address, I have been asked by many people what I would say if I were the one giving a speech tonight. After all, next year's State of the Commonwealth Address hopefully will be up to me.
From my vantage point, the state of the Commonwealth is: Resilient.
Please see more of what I have to say by clicking on the video above or by clicking the button below:

As we work to recover from the pandemic, let's do more than just rebuild our state. Let's make it even better than it ever was before. Let's make a state we can be proud to not just live in today, but to be the place we want our kids and grandkids to live when they grow up.
I'm convinced we can do it, together.
As always, I gratefully appreciate your support.
Sincerely,

# Bill McSwain Calls on PA General Assembly to Immediately Repeal Unconstitutional Act 77
**West Chester, Pa.** **\-- **In response to the Friday morning Commonwealth Court ruling that Act 77 is unconstitutional, Bill McSwain, Republican candidate for Governor, called on the PA General Assembly to immediately repeal Act 77:
---
|
> _**"To have any unconstitutional law enacted in our Commonwealth is unacceptable, and I am calling on the Pennsylvania General Assembly to immediately repeal Act 77.
>
> Act 77 has introduced chaos, turmoil, and inconsistencies into our elections - forcing** **counties to navigate a deluge of misplaced, incorrect, or duplicate ballots, and complicating what should otherwise be straightforward outcomes.
>
> The Pennsylvania General Assembly has an inherent duty to enact laws that adhere to our Commonwealth's constitution and to ensure transparent and secure elections for all Pennsylvanians. The way to do this is through the immediate repeal of Act 77 and a return to in-person voting and the sanctity of the voting booth.
>
> Unlike with mail-in voting, there is no opportunity in the voting booth for anybody to fill out your ballot for you, exert any influence or pressure on you, or harvest your ballot. There is also no opportunity for your ballot to fall into the wrong hands, unlike when ballots are mailed out to millions of addresses using imperfect and outdated voter rolls.
>
> The best way to encourage more people to vote is to have an election system in which people have faith. That will occur when we have leaders who are dedicated to upholding our state's constitution and to protecting the fundamental rights of all citizens. I have always fought against the chaos of universal mail-in balloting. If Tom Wolf vetoes the Pennsylvania General Assembly's repeal of Act 77, I will, as Governor, sign the repeal of this unconstitutional legislation on day one." **_
---
|
---
| **BACKGROUND: **
Appointed by President Trump, McSwain's record as US Attorney demonstrates his fierce defense of constitutional rights, dedication to upholding law and order, and history of putting criminals and corrupt politicians in jail. Prior to becoming an attorney, Bill served as a scout/sniper platoon commander in the U.S. Marine Corps. He was born in Philadelphia and raised in Chester County, where he lives today with his wife, Stephanie, and their four children. More information on McSwain's background and platform is available [here.](https://freedompapac.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b9af0aef3fa3167622552aedb&id=b9e70b8dd4&e=b1ec95759b)

Fellow American,

It seems to me that despite a few challenges from the Left, Democrats by and large stand for the same priorities - and vote for them, too.

But what do we as Republicans stand for these days? Have you taken a step back lately and asked yourself why you’re a conservative? Have you thought about what Republicans stand for?

Are we conservative because we believe it’s essential to make the government more accountable to the people of the United States? Maybe you’re a conservative because you support a strong military and low taxes. Perhaps you vote Republican because Republicans have traditionally been the party that favors pro-life legislation.

Dear Patriot,

What a week it has been! We have seen the STOCK MARKET go on a wild ride, had a Supreme Court Justice say it is time to retire, Russia looks ready to invade Ukraine and President Biden get so frustrated with a press question that he called the reporter a name not suitable for a family newsletter!

It is in times like these that we need to come together and realize that the conservative values that we believe in are worth fighting for. That is why each week on [**The Doug Collins Podcast**](http://click1.srnemail.com/pdhvmlrrmgybggkrbyyshbdgwmbclwwgqlskwqyqvcfyyj_esthhttytsyqfrhtytsthst.html) we strive to give you information you can use on several subjects that lets you feel equipped for the daily battles we face as a country and in our families. I believe that we must be prepared to take our message to everyone we can find to ensure that the LIBERAL press and Democratic Congress are kept in check.

This week also has been another big week for our podcast. We have launched the VIDEO portion of our podcast. Friend, Tomorrow is the end of National School Choice Week. Each week, I talk to parents all across Illinois who are frustrated with the state of our schools. Parents have lost rights that should have never even been in question. This week and every week, Carolyn and I have been sharing why we are supporting our Parents Bill of Rights. If you haven't read it yet, you can find it [here](https://www.schimpf4illinois.com/illinois_parents_bill_of_rights?e=1469e37fec1f8638fc00965d010776f6&utm_source=schimpf4illinois&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=schimpf_from_the_trail_01_28&n=2) to see exactly what we are supporting. Parents, not the government, have the authority and responsibility to raise their children to the best of their ability in accordance with their values. It's time for commonsense, conservative leadership that we can trust.
* * *
**Volunteer of the Week** This week's volunteer to highlight is our friend, Larry Kaifesh! Larry and Paul first met while working on a Marine Corps Legislative Fellowship in the US House of Representatives in DC. Larry has acted as a surrogate speaker for the campaign on multiple occasions. Thank you to Larry for his friendship, work on the campaign, and, most importantly, service to our country! [If you'd like to volunteer on our campaign, click here.](https://www.schimpf4illinois.com/volunteer?e=1469e37fec1f8638fc00965d010776f6&utm_source=schimpf4illinois&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=schimpf_from_the_trail_01_28&n=3)
* * *
**Social Media Spotlight** This week, my running mate Carolyn attended an event hosted by Americans for Prosperity Illinois in honor of #NationalSchoolChoiceWeek. Carolyn loved hearing Former Lt. Governor Evelyn Sanguinetti's story and learning more about how important school choice is, especially now. "Inflation is at a 40-year high. The last time it was 7 percent, Olivia Newton John topped the charts and parachute pants were the latest trend. It’s only been one year of Joe Biden and Democrats’ one-party “leadership,” yet American families are feeling the squeeze now more than ever. The cost of groceries, the cost to buy goods, and the cost to fill up your gas tank are all higher.” ... “My mom taught me the importance of valuing my pennies when I was a little girl, and I’m going to Washington to be a real fiscal conservative. | | | Folks,

I wanted to make sure you saw this message from my team. As mentioned, this race is going to start ramping up so we are going to need all hands on deck. The importance of this race has gotten even more clear.

**[](https://MikeVanSomeren.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a8d3e4f455e56b0d81700f39a&id=897b8d965d&e=356c0699dd)**_Read more[here](https://MikeVanSomeren.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a8d3e4f455e56b0d81700f39a&id=165bbe2a40&e=356c0699dd). _

I have stressed my commitment to protecting the democratic process. It has come to light that my opponent, **Scott Fitzgerald** , has been helping to **undermine that process**. We cannot stand by as lawmakers like Scott Fitzgerald remain in office. With your support, we can protect American democracy.
---
| [Donate](https://MikeVanSomeren.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a8d3e4f455e56b0d81700f39a&id=ba22d86fb2&e=356c0699dd "Donate")
---
| Attempting to overturn an election is no small matter and the officials who were a part of attempting to overturn the last election must be held accountable. The best way to do that is to remove those people from the government that they don’t respect. If you are ready for a representative who will stand up for democracy rather than try to tear it down, [consider making a contribution of $50, $25, $10 or whatever you are able to give today.](https://MikeVanSomeren.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a8d3e4f455e56b0d81700f39a&id=b18e9e4ff7&e=356c0699dd)

Thank you for your continued support,

Mike
---
|
---
| Hi there,

The first month of the year has flown by. Mike had a great start in 2021. It was incredible to see the amount of support that his campaign has received but now the race is going to heat up. For Mike Van Someren to come out on top, we are going to need even more support in the upcoming weeks and months.

Mike has already hit the ground running this year. As a passionate believer in American Democracy, he has already laid out a [Common Sense Plan to Restore America’s Democracy](https://MikeVanSomeren.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a8d3e4f455e56b0d81700f39a&id=0301e3c03f&e=356c0699dd) ensuring that the people have a real say on who gets to represent them. He understands that democracy is something that must be maintained in order for it to truly work. If you are ready for a representative who wants to listen to you and work for you representing your interests in Washington, [could you set up a recurring donation of $50, $25, $10 or whatever you can give each month?](https://MikeVanSomeren.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a8d3e4f455e56b0d81700f39a&id=b8dd01b37b&e=356c0699dd) For less than the cost of your monthly Netflix subscription you can help ensure the campaign is able to communicate with voters and get the message out that there is someone that wants to listen to and work for everyday people like you.

name: John Fetterman
subject: the story behind my tattoos
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Fetterman for PA
body:
I’m going to tell you about my tattoos, Derek.
#
Derek,
We both know I don’t look like a typical politician. Maybe that’s why my tattoos are *literally* the first thing people Google about me.
[](https://act.johnfetterman.com/go/42122?refcode=em20220128-4369&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=4369%2E434096%2EqPHJVk)
Well enough Googling. Today I’ll tell you about my tattoos myself, Derek.
**On my left arm I have the zip code 15104.** That’s Braddock, Pennsylvania, my home and the community I was honored to serve as mayor for 15 years. Gisele and I are raising our kids here in Braddock, right across the street from Andrew Carnegie’s first steel mill.
[](https://act.johnfetterman.com/go/42122?refcode=em20220128-4369&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=4369%2E434096%2EqPHJVk)
**On my right arm I have nine different dates.** These are the dates when people were killed through violence in Braddock while I served as mayor, starting in 2005. Seven out of nine were gun deaths. I actually have to get one more date added because in June of 2018, there was another tragic loss of life.
[](https://act.johnfetterman.com/go/42122?refcode=em20220128-4369&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=4369%2E434096%2EqPHJVk)
My first tattoo came after January 16, 2006. It was my second week on the job as mayor after winning my election by a single vote. I received a call and was summoned to a police crime scene where a pizza delivery man had been robbed and killed by gun violence.
**Every time Braddock lost someone was the worst feeling in the world, Derek.** In a close-knit community like Braddock, it’s very likely that you know the victim and their family. It’s an incredibly wrenching and personal experience as a mayor — but nothing compared to what the families have to go through.
In my 15 years as mayor, I worked with the community to take on gun violence and other important issues that Braddock faced every day. I helped initiate youth and art programs for the students of our community and we worked together to create a community center.
We also worked to develop buildings that had been written off, kick-started our economy, and reduced deadly violence. My proudest moment as Mayor of Braddock is when our community went 5 1⁄2 years without the loss of life due to gun violence.
**Derek, I’m running for the U.S. Senate because I believe that every community is worth fighting for.** And I *promise* that I will fight for every Pennsylvanian.
But in order to build the kind of campaign that can win, we need to raise *a lot* of money. A big part of that is people like you chipping in. With our first end-of-month deadline of Election Year just around the corner, I have to ask:
[Will you please make your very first $5 donation to our campaign right now, Derek? Every dollar helps send me to the U.S. Senate where I’ll fight like hell for your community just like I fight for mine.](https://act.johnfetterman.com/go/42122?refcode=em20220128-4369&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=4&akid=4369%2E434096%2EqPHJVk)
**[Contribute $5](https://act.johnfetterman.com/go/42122?refcode=em20220128-4369&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=23&akid=4369%2E434096%2EqPHJVk)**
Thanks for all you do,
John
John Fetterman
Lieutenant Governor of Pennsylvania

**[Donate](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-emails?refcode=em20220128-4369-footer&t=24&refcode2=4369_434096_qPHJVk&akid=4369%2E434096%2EqPHJVk)**

Fellow patriot,

Democrats love to virtue signal non-stop, and cancel anyone who disagrees with them. For a long time, it worked.

Now, we’re seeing Republicans of all stripes filing to run for office, saying what’s on their mind, and defending our shared beliefs.

subject: Oops, Here’s Something Biden Wants You to Forget About Gas Prices
body:
\-- Last month the White House was so desperate for things to brag about in a year-end memo that they boasted about gas prices. According to the memo, the White House was proud to boast that the “price of gas at the pump has decreased nearly 10 cents since its peak, and continuing [sic] to fall.” The memo failed to mention that when gas prices peaked in November, they were roughly a dollar per gallon more than when Biden took office. Nor did it say that the price of oil crashed at the end of November due to fears of more COVID-related lockdowns. So he could barely even claim that his raiding of the Strategic Petroleum Reserve was a huge factor in the price of gas falling. Nevertheless, the Biden White House decided then to accept responsibility for gas prices. They claimed it was an accomplishment. They took ownership of gas prices from that point on. Well, guess what? Gas prices are heading back up, and are approaching seven-year highs. Oops. So what is the White House to do, now that they’ve claimed credit for gas prices? I suspect that the White House to return to using the same “high gas prices are good” rhetoric we heard last year. “Look, our view is that the rise in gas prices over the long term makes an even stronger case for doubling down on our investment and our focus on clean energy options, so we are not relying on the fluctuations and OPEC and their willingness to put more supply and meet the demand in the market,” Psaki said back in November. Remember how Barack Obama’s investment in clean energy worked out? |

clean_body: \-- Last month the White House was so desperate for things to brag about in a year-end memo that they boasted about gas prices. According to the memo, the White House was proud to boast that the “price of gas at the pump has decreased nearly 10 cents since its peak, and continuing [sic] to fall.” The memo failed to mention that when gas prices peaked in November, they were roughly a dollar per gallon more than when Biden took office. Nor did it say that the price of oil crashed at the end of November due to fears of more COVID-related lockdowns. So he could barely even claim that his raiding of the Strategic Petroleum Reserve was a huge factor in the price of gas falling. Nevertheless, the Biden White House decided then to accept responsibility for gas prices. They claimed it was an accomplishment. They took ownership of gas prices from that point on. Well, guess what? Gas prices are heading back up, and are approaching seven-year highs. Oops. So what is the White House to do, now that they’ve claimed credit for gas prices? I suspect that the White House to return to using the same “high gas prices are good” rhetoric we heard last year. “Look, our view is that the rise in gas prices over the long term makes an even stronger case for doubling down on our investment and our focus on clean energy options, so we are not relying on the fluctuations and OPEC and their willingness to put more supply and meet the demand in the market,” Psaki said back in November. ### **Opponents launch TV ads **
A couple of my opponents have launched a TV ad buy. One of those opponents is Aurora Mayor Richard Irvin.
Here is the statement my campaign released on his ad which hit on the crime issue.
“Pretend Republican candidate for Governor, Richard Irvin, continues the deception today as he rolls out his commercials claiming to be the law-and-order candidate. Let’s do a reality check. Irvin has spent the last twenty years representing criminals and doing his best to keep them out of jail. His clients aren’t just low-level criminals but rather the full range of bad guys from domestic violence offenders to murderers. The crime rates during his tenure as Mayor of Aurora, his support for defunding the police, sanctuary cities and BLM, tells us loud and clear that his approach to law and order is right out of the Kim Foxx - JB Pritzker woke playbook, where victims are an afterthought and justice is only served when the jails are empty.
But it goes beyond helping criminals beat the rap. Last election, ‘Democrat-running-as-a-Republican-Irvin’ fully supported his criminal defense attorney law partner as she ran against a law-and-order Republican in Kane County. Yes, the guy seeking the nomination for Governor as a Republican fully and actively supported a far-left criminal defense lawyer over a law-and-order Republican. Don’t be fooled by the smokescreen. Richard Irvin is a left-leaning Democrat and does not support the polices that will end the crime wave in Illinois. We do not need another Democrat as Illinois Governor.”
### Illinois is one of the worst states to retire
A new report from WalletHub shows Illinois is the sixth-worst state in the country for seniors to retire.
Despite the fact that Illinois does NOT tax retirement income, Illinois came in dead last in the state’s taxpayer ranking, one of the measures for the report.
Property taxes and other taxes retirees must pay are the culprits.
Do we need any more evidence that Illinois taxes are too high? One reason Illinois does not tax retirement income is to keep retirees in the state, but because of the state’s gas taxes, property taxes, sales taxes, and utility taxes, any income tax benefits retirees enjoy are negated.
We need real reform, but the current leadership will never give us the reforms we need. It is time for a new direction. Crushing property taxes and keeping retirees in Illinois will be one of my top priorities as Governor of Illinois.
### Illinois students struggle with SATs
Test-Guide has released a study on SAT and ACT test scores and unfortunately Illinois does not fare too well.
According to the report, Illinois ranks the 7th lowest in the country for SAT scores. In fact, Illinois scored 10.3% below the national average for the SAT. Surrounding states such as Iowa, Indiana, Michigan, and Minnesota all had higher test scores than Illinois.
We need to be doing a better job of preparing our college-bound students. Instead of focusing on critical race theory and other far-left propaganda in our schools, we need to make sure our students have the basic knowledge they need to further their education. As Governor, I will make sure our schools focus on critical learning, not critical race theory.

body:
The Let 'Em Go Guys allow more chaos on the streets on Los Angeles. | | |
---
| | Train robberies in 2022?

Like most of you, I was stunned earlier this month to learn that criminals had been looting thousands of packages from the back of cargo trains in Los Angeles. Thefts were up over 200% in the last year. The images were reminiscent of an old western movie, except sadly the thefts were occurring in 2022 not the 1800s, and the thieves were being prosecuted by The Let 'Em Go Guys (AG Rob Bonta, LA DA George Gascon, and SF DA Chesa Boudin). As Union Pacific complained, the LA DA’s office had become nothing more than a turnstile for these thieves since even when they were prosecuted, which was rarely, they often were back at the tracks within 24 hours with zero bail facing nothing more than a no-jail misdemeanor.

I was at the train tracks last week discussing this chaos. Check out my video below:

name: Emily  Burns
subject: Re: Join the Ground Game, for Emily Burns' run for Congress--SIGN UP TODAY
body:
Hello!

Thank you so much for your interest and support of my campaign. There are several of you here who have donated, and whom I have yet to thank, as I am still behind on thank you notes—they are coming.

In the mean time, we are starting our ground game. In addition to standard door-knocking and signatures the campaign is going to be very event heavy.

**Please sign up to get involved,[ here](https://forms.wix.com/07b9d674-db49-49d6-b4f5-3ea251781925:ee0d51c3-36c0-41be-a183-207539e4cf87). There are MANY different ways you can volunteer. If you want to help—or simply join in—please, sign up.**

We are starting a “Back to Normal” tour, where we will be visiting every town in the district, with coffees, parent round tables, small business round tables, as well as casual, social walks.

We are also starting a “conversations” series, where we will have conversations about key issues with a heterodox spin. Think masking with a doctor and a physicist who think masks are over-sold; discussing affordable housing with a developer who is a small-government conservative; environmentalism focused on results, not methods; or life-long liberals who are voting straight R this year, and why.

Your engagement in the campaign is/will be hugely helpful to me, and I thank you for your prior engagement, and in advance for your future support. I also think it will be a great way for you all to find like-minded people in the area. And by that, I don’t mean Republicans, per se. I mean people who feel passionately that we have taken a terribly wrong turn and need to find our way back to normal. Of course, I have significant support from Republicans, but there is also a large independent and disaffected progressive/democrat contingency among my supporters. My campaign is not about party, it is about policies, and having the conversations we must have to drive the policies we need to get back on the right track.

The campaign is truly off to an incredible start—I cannot thank you enough for that. This is a tough district, a district that many typical donors have given up on. Despite that, in the 1st quarter of fundraising, we raised nearly 3x what the Republican who ran last cycle raised during the entire campaign—and not from the typical donors. More importantly, Jake (the incumbent), raised $400K. We raised $355K. This momentum is from people who are newly engaged, people who have gotten involved and donated because they are furious. As someone said at my [kick-off event](https://www.emilyburns.vote/post/the-journey-back-to-normal), **_it feels like a[ movement](https://boriquagato.substack.com/p/back-to-the-future-of-american-politics?justPublished=true)._** That matters, because while a red wave alone might work to put candidates into office in other parts of the country, only a cross-party movement will work in this district.

Welcome to the #BackToNormal movement. It’s been too long 😊

Sincerely,

Emily

P.S.
Feel free to forward this email to others whom you think would be interested in being involved.

P.P.S
This is my personal email. Feel free to use it as a direct line to me. I look forward to hearing from you.

________________________________________________

Emily Burns
Candidate for Massachusetts’ 4th Congressional District (R)
[LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/emilyvburns/) / [Twitter](https://twitter.com/Emily_Burns_V) / [ Campaign Site](https://www.emilyburns.vote/)
